before.reviewedBy: Codex source and named state assertion review
before.rationale: 真实pet4829/bb6407d2、soul2019/1c323b15与全部9招29实例；无factor或advance，API与Wiki均保留9招，不以超级形态/强化名称延期。1065按已有先回血再等量附伤确认取净HP增加；异常类型和概率直接来自源实例，不沿用旧处理器硬编码。
before.singleBehavior: 首次按30%体力完整分档授麻痹免疫回合，成功消敌回合和强化；每回合初快照敌无强化红增50%、敌无回合先制1、双满足战阶魂印回复1/3；实际攻击使用后比例吸取，免疫或共享转换事件增长10个百分点封顶60%，达到60%免全部异常，当前在场所有分支验证。

success.name: 4829真实2019首次满体麻痹免疫3回合，免疫成功消敌回合消正且计数，其他异常不误免疫
success.assertion: const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.kabuda2019.entryEnd,3);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.a.stages.def=3;assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.stages.def,0);assert.equal(c.a.effects['攻击必中'],undefined);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.kabuda2019.count,1);assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),true);}},()=>turn(s));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);

success.name: 4829真实2019回合初无强化红伤50%、无回合先制1与双条件战阶魂印回血，条件快照不追溯
success.assertion: for(const [boost,timed,wantPriority,wantHeal]of [[false,false,4,3000],[true,false,4,0],[false,true,3,0],[true,true,3,0]]){const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[1].effects={};if(boost)s.fighters[1].stages.def=1;if(timed)timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,wantPriority);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2800+wantHeal);const base=make({move:38132,index:-1,hp:1000});base.fighters[1].effects={};if(boost)base.fighters[1].stages.def=1;turn(base);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(base)*(boost?1:1.5))<=2);}

success.name: 4829真实2019攻击使用后20%吸取含MISS与命中零伤，属性药剂未用不吸取，百分免疫仍理论回复
success.assertion:
for(const mode of ['normal','miss','zero','immune-percent']){const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='immune-percent')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2800);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune-percent'?0:1800);if(['miss','zero'].includes(mode))assert.equal(sum(s),0);}
 for(const mode of ['status','potion','not-used']){const s=make({move:29180,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});if(mode==='not-used')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=99;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:29180);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);}

success.name: 4829真实2019各来源免疫累计四次到60%且此后免全部异常不耗次数，重复尝试计数封顶
success.assertion:
const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){for(let n=1;n<=4;n++){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.t,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.kabuda2019.count,n);}c.a.counts.immune=2;assert.equal(c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.counts.immune,2);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.kabuda2019.count,4);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),5400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,6400);
 const a=make({move:29180,index:-1,soul:true});a.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.t,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.counts.immune,0);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.kabuda2019.count,1);}},()=>turn(a));

interaction.assertion: const old=E.SOULS;let seen=false;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1){c.a.stages.atk=2;c.a.effects.testEntry={start:1,end:2};assert.equal(c.entryAilment(c.t,'麻痹',2,c.a),false);assert.equal(c.a.stages.atk,0);assert.equal(c.a.effects.testEntry,undefined);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.kabuda2019.count,1);c.t.counts.immune=1;assert.equal(c.entryAilment(c.t,'中毒',2,c.a),false);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.kabuda2019.count,2);seen=true;}}};try{make({move:29180,index:-1,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(seen,true);

before.deferredBehavior: 仅真实换宠重登场时重新按当时体力授麻痹免疫，并重置“本次在场”免疫/转化计数与增长吸取资源。首次登场、当前双方和已核实共享转换状态不延期。
before.trigger: 自身下场后再次登场
futureMechanisms: 换宠事件
重复登场事件
在场资源生命周期

dependencyEvidence.quote: 登场时
本次在场

after.reviewedBy: Codex source and named state assertion review
after.rationale: 真实pet4829/bb6407d2、soul2019/1c323b15与全部9招29实例；无factor或advance，API与Wiki均保留9招，不以超级形态/强化名称延期。1065按已有先回血再等量附伤确认取净HP增加；异常类型和概率直接来自源实例，不沿用旧处理器硬编码。
after.singleBehavior: 首次按30%体力完整分档授麻痹免疫回合，成功消敌回合和强化；每回合初快照敌无强化红增50%、敌无回合先制1、双满足战阶魂印回复1/3；实际攻击使用后比例吸取，免疫或共享转换事件增长10个百分点封顶60%，达到60%免全部异常，当前在场所有分支验证。

success.name: 4829真实2019首次满体麻痹免疫3回合，免疫成功消敌回合消正且计数，其他异常不误免疫
success.assertion: const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.kabuda2019.entryEnd,3);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.a.stages.def=3;assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.stages.def,0);assert.equal(c.a.effects['攻击必中'],undefined);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.kabuda2019.count,1);assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),true);}},()=>turn(s));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);

success.name: 4829真实2019回合初无强化红伤50%、无回合先制1与双条件战阶魂印回血，条件快照不追溯
success.assertion: for(const [boost,timed,wantPriority,wantHeal]of [[false,false,4,3000],[true,false,4,0],[false,true,3,0],[true,true,3,0]]){const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[1].effects={};if(boost)s.fighters[1].stages.def=1;if(timed)timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,wantPriority);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2800+wantHeal);const base=make({move:38132,index:-1,hp:1000});base.fighters[1].effects={};if(boost)base.fighters[1].stages.def=1;turn(base);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(base)*(boost?1:1.5))<=2);}

success.name: 4829真实2019攻击使用后20%吸取含MISS与命中零伤，属性药剂未用不吸取，百分免疫仍理论回复
success.assertion:
for(const mode of ['normal','miss','zero','immune-percent']){const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='immune-percent')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2800);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune-percent'?0:1800);if(['miss','zero'].includes(mode))assert.equal(sum(s),0);}
 for(const mode of ['status','potion','not-used']){const s=make({move:29180,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});if(mode==='not-used')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=99;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:29180);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);}

success.name: 4829真实2019各来源免疫累计四次到60%且此后免全部异常不耗次数，重复尝试计数封顶
success.assertion:
const s=make({move:38132,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){for(let n=1;n<=4;n++){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.t,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.kabuda2019.count,n);}c.a.counts.immune=2;assert.equal(c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.counts.immune,2);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.kabuda2019.count,4);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),5400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,6400);
 const a=make({move:29180,index:-1,soul:true});a.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.t,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.counts.immune,0);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.kabuda2019.count,1);}},()=>turn(a));

before.rationale: 首次当前对手流血、当前双方减伤/免控/吸取全部自身分支；仅再次登场延期，已有流血免弱时长仍单精灵待答。常驻免疫优先回合反弹复用既有公共A确认，不重复询问。
before.singleBehavior: 首次按对手30%体力完整分档施流血；已有流血可确认延长分档数，但免弱时长Q-4830-001明确报待答。敌非流血攻固粉减25%，受两种后剩余种类减50%、真伤不减。敌流血常驻免控，前2次每次延长流血1，计入同一首回合登场触发；战阶固定吸取100+每回合流血100，按理论吸取量回复，免固则清敌回合且受免断保护。

after.rationale: 首次当前对手流血、当前双方减伤/免控/吸取全部自身分支；仅再次登场延期，已有流血免弱时长仍单精灵待答。常驻免疫优先回合反弹复用既有公共A确认，不重复询问。
after.singleBehavior: 首次按对手30%体力完整分档施流血；已有流血可确认延长分档数，但免弱时长Q-4830-001明确报待答。敌非流血攻固粉减25%，受两种后剩余种类减50%、真伤不减。敌流血常驻免控，前2次每次延长流血1，计入同一首回合登场触发；战阶固定吸取100+每回合流血100，按理论吸取量回复，免固则清敌回合且受免断保护。

success.name: 4830真实2020满体登场流血3回合，体力30%分档边界及免异失败不补抽；已有流血免弱明确待答
4830真实2020敌无流血时攻固粉先25%第三类50%、真伤不减与逐回合清种类；其他异常不误判流血
success.assertion: const s=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});delete s.fighters[1].ailments['流血'];s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=99;const out=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const t of['fixed','percent','fixed','true'])out.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'三通道真实状态',t));},()=>turn(s,29182,10127));assert.deepEqual(out,[75,50,75,100]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.damageTypes2016.types,['attack','fixed','percent']);const next=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)next.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'新回合固定首伤','fixed'));},()=>turn(s,29182));assert.deepEqual(next,[75]);

success.name: 4830真实2020敌流血时不减伤且免控每回合前2次延长流血，第三次不延长、非控次数免异不冒充
success.assertion: const s=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});for(let r=1;r<=2;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const start=c.a.ailments['流血'];for(let n=1;n<=3;n++){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],start+Math.min(n,2));}c.t.counts.immune=1;assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,0);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],start+2);assert.equal(c.hurt(c.t,100,'流血关闭固定减伤','fixed'),100);}},()=>turn(s,29182));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shark2020.controls,2);

success.name: 4830真实2020战阶100加每剩余流血回合100固定吸取，理论回复不受目标低HP与免伤截断，免固才清回合
4830真实2020免固清回合可被保护，固伤护罩不视为免疫，死亡不复活
success.assertion:
const a=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});a.fighters[1].suitState.barrier=1000;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1400);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'].end,99);
 const b=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1});turn(b,29182,10127);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(sum(b,'fixed'),0);

success.name: 4830真实2020公共登场免控延长计入首回合前2次，首回合初不重置，次回合再可延长
success.assertion:
const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.entryAilment(c.t,'害怕',2,c.a),false);assert.equal(c.entryAilment(c.t,'麻痹',2,c.a),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],5);}}};let s;try{s=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}
 observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],5);}},()=>turn(s));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],6);}},()=>turn(s));

success.name: 4830真实2020常驻免控先于技能反弹，不反弹仍延长两次；免固清回合受免断保护
success.assertion:
const a=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true});timer(a,0,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const before=c.a.ailments['流血'];assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['流血'],before+1);}},()=>turn(a));
 const b=make({move:29182,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(b,1,'固定百分比免疫');timer(b,1,'protect');turn(b);assert.equal(sum(b,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,1400);assert.ok(b.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比免疫']);assert.ok(b.fighters[1].effects.protect);

success.name: 4850真实2040回初流血剩余回合红增15%封顶90%，固粉真不增
success.assertion: const base=make({move:10001,index:-1});turn(base);const red=sum(base);for(const n of[0,1,6,9]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});if(n)s.fighters[0].ailments['流血']=n;const other=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true'])other.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'测试非红',type));},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pharaoh2040.bonus,Math.min(90,n*15));assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-red*(1+Math.min(90,n*15)/100))<=2);assert.deepEqual(other,[100,100,100]);}

success.name: 4850真实2040流血免异先于回合反弹及次数，逐次延长含自身流血，未流血不免
success.assertion:
const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['流血']=3;timer(s,0,'reflect');s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){for(const k of['害怕','流血','中毒'])assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,k,c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(c.t.ailments['流血'],6);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);assert.equal(c.a.ailments['害怕'],undefined);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pharaoh2040.remaining,3);
 const b=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),true);},()=>turn(b));assert.ok(b.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);

success.name: 4850真实2040完整红大于300：原有敌流血改全强，否则敌我流血；敌免异仍自流血、击杀不省自身

 const immune=make({move:38195,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:1500}});immune.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(immune);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].ailments['流血'],undefined);assert.ok(immune.fighters[0].ailments['流血']);const ko=make({move:38195,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:1500},targetHp:1});turn(ko);assert.ok(sum(ko)>300);assert.ok(ko.fighters[0].ailments['流血']);const small=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});turn(small);assert.ok(sum(small)<=300);assert.equal(small.fighters[0].ailments['流血'],undefined);

after.rationale: 唱词、曝、额外行动和四个固有效果均为自身当前机制；只把原文具体换宠、下只或场下对象分支延期，不以伙伴名称或引擎缺口延期。 永沐概率执行观察已补接原生技能、魂印、定时反应和特性；只观察原随机值，不重新抽样、不改变原概率或条件；真实3012/3066/3025/3737及特性成功失败均有状态变化与随机流对照。
after.singleBehavior: 当前在场永沐执行概率条件附曝、曝封死亡与消逝、唱词资源与叠加固有触发、回初唱词减红；眷颂字段差异/破黯伤害/曝减抗等Q-4853-001到006保持部分未实现。

success.assertion: const seen=new Set(),o={id:3012,ids:[24685,19187,24686,19188,19189],move:19187};for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const a=battle({...o,seed}),b=battle({...o,seed,observer:false});go(a,o.move);go(b,o.move);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].soulState.exposure4853);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].soulState.exposure4853,undefined);assert.ok(a.ailmentExecutions4853.some(e=>e.actorSide===1&&e.chance===50));assert.ok(a.ailmentExecutions4853.some(e=>e.actorSide===1&&e.chance===30));seen.add(!!a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);assert.deepEqual(a.damageEvents,b.damageEvents);for(let i=0;i<2;i++){assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].pp,b.fighters[i].pp);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].ailments,b.fighters[i].ailments);}}assert.equal(seen.size,2);

success.name: 4853真实五星表内高热与火热特性8%异常执行失败也曝，非异常特性不因低概率附曝
success.assertion:
const C=E.CHARACTERISTICS,o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false};for(const group of[24,45]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=battle({...o,seed});a.moveDefinitions[key(16076)].operations=[];a.moveDefinitions[key(38213)].operations=[];a.fighters[1].build.characteristic=C.normalize({groupId:group,star:5});go(a,16076,38213);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].soulState.exposure4853);assert.ok(a.ailmentExecutions4853.some(e=>e.actorSide===1&&e.chance===8));seen.add(!!a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}
 const b=battle(o);b.moveDefinitions[key(16076)].operations=[];b.fighters[1].build.characteristic=C.normalize({groupId:C.groups.find(g=>g.name==='会心').id,star:5});go(b,16076);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].soulState.exposure4853,undefined);

failure.assertion: const base=make({move:38206,index:-1});turn(base,38206,10127);for(const n of[0,1,3]){const a=make({move:38206,index:-1,soul:true});lyric.lyricState4853(a.fighters[0]).list=Array(n).fill(2372);const other=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){lyric.gainLyric4853({...c,a:c.t},2373);for(const type of['fixed','percent','true'])other.push(c.hurt(c.t,100,'非红',type));}},()=>turn(a,38206,10127));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.lyricFrame4853.count,n);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a,'attack',1)-sum(base,'attack',1)*(1-n*.15))<=2);assert.deepEqual(other,[100,100,100]);}

before.reviewedBy: Codex exact source and current-field state assertions
before.rationale: 真实原生魂印2048/3088bd58：首次双方沉默及当前在场全部减伤/回复/次回强化已测；只登记来源每次登场对应的未来真实再次登场分支，不延期首次或当前效果。
before.singleBehavior: 首次双方独立100%沉默；回初快照沉默固粉减20%与独立减伤共存，敌无沉默实际攻击后魂印回300；战阶按实际敌用攻与完整红伤授次回攻击先制1或2，当前自身红伤0授次回命中附完整红伤50%粉，正红清资格、命中零红不错误补偿。

success.name: 4863真实2048入场双方分别100%沉默，公共独立时长、免异各自消费及反弹不补抽
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048入场双方分别100%沉默，公共独立时长、免异各自消费及反弹不补抽',()=>{const a=make({soul:true});for(const f of a.fighters)assert.ok([2,3].includes(f.ailments['沉默']));const b=make({soul:true,entryImmune:1});assert.equal(b.fighters[1].ailments['沉默'],undefined);assert.ok(b.fighters[0].ailments['沉默']);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);const c=make({soul:true,selfEntryImmune:1});assert.equal(c.fighters[0].ailments['沉默'],undefined);assert.ok(c.fighters[1].ailments['沉默']);assert.equal(c.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);});

success.name: 4863真实2048回初敌沉默快照减固粉20%，真伤红伤不减，中途移除沉默不撤快照
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048回初敌沉默快照减固粉20%，真伤红伤不减，中途移除沉默不撤快照',()=>{const a=native({move:10086});a.fighters[1].ailments['沉默']=3;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){delete c.a.ailments['沉默'];for(const [type,want]of[['fixed',800],['percent',800],['true',1000]]){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'独立减伤状态验证',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,want);}}},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.opponentSilent,true);});

success.name: 4863真实2048回初敌无沉默当回合实际攻击后回血300，MISS/整招无效仍用攻，控制/属性/药剂不触，技能禁疗不阻魂印
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048回初敌无沉默当回合实际攻击后回血300，MISS/整招无效仍用攻，控制/属性/药剂不触，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','miss','blocked','control','status','potion']){const a=native({move:10086,hp:1000});timer(a,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='miss')timer(a,1,'攻击必失');if(mode==='blocked')timer(a,1,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;let before,after;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='opponentAfterUse'&&c.a.side===0){if(before==null)before=c.a.hp;after=c.a.hp;}},()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='opponentAfterUse'&&c.a.side===0)before=c.a.hp;},()=>turn(a,10086,mode==='status'?20117:mode==='potion'?null:10127),true));if(['hit','miss','blocked'].includes(mode))assert.equal(after-before,300);else assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000);}const snapshot=native({move:10086,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.t,'沉默',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(snapshot,10086,10127));assert.equal(snapshot.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.opponentSilent,false);assert.ok(snapshot.fighters[0].hp>1000-100);});

success.name: 4863真实2048敌实际用攻授下回合攻击先制1，未受红伤额外1；属性招不加、未行动不授、正完整伤害保1仍算受红
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048敌实际用攻授下回合攻击先制1，未受红伤额外1；属性招不加、未行动不授、正完整伤害保1仍算受红',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=native({move:10086});if(immune)timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPriority,immune?2:1);s.moveDefinitions[key(38238)].operations=[];turn(s,38238);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,3+(immune?2:1));}for(const mode of['status','control']){const s=native({move:10086});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,10086,mode==='status'?20117:10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPriority,0);}});

success.name: 4863真实2048本回合红伤0授仅下回合命中附完整结算红伤50%粉，MISS与已命中零红区分，正红不授
success.assertion: test('4863真实2048本回合红伤0授仅下回合命中附完整结算红伤50%粉，MISS与已命中零红区分，正红不授',()=>{const s=native({move:10086,hit:false});timer(s,0,'攻击必失');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,2);delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必失'];s.moveDefinitions[key(38238)].operations=[];turn(s,38238);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),Math.floor(sum(s)*.5));assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,null);turn(s,38238);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);const a=native({move:10086});turn(a,20182);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,2);const zero=native({move:10086});timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.silenceFrame2048.nextPercentRound,2);turn(zero);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(sum(zero,'percent'),0);});

success.assertion: test('4865真实2050加速下两回合全技能先制独立累计与到期，百分比免疫零伤不算受到加速伤害而触交错待答',()=>{const s=make({move:10361,soul:true});for(const n of[0,1,2]){turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n);}turn(s,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.spacetime2050.windows.length,3);s.moveDefinitions[key(29251)].operations=[];turn(s,29251);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);turn(s,29251);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);const immune=make({move:10361,soul:true});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(immune),/Q-4865-001/);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].hp,9000);});

success.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空折跃按实际已损60%魂印回血与净回复等量粉，200边界神游清异常，技能禁疗不阻魂印且回复倍率归零触发未回复分支',()=>{for(const [hp,restored]of[[1000,4800],[8500,300],[8665,201],[8666,200],[9000,0]]){const s=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true,hp});s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');let before,after;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){after=c.a.hp;assert.equal(c.a.hp,hp+restored);assert.equal(!!c.t.ailments['神游'],restored<=200);assert.equal(!!c.a.ailments['烧伤'],restored>200);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(after,hp+restored);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),300+restored);}const no=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(no,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:1});turn(no);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(sum(no,'percent'),300);assert.ok(no.fighters[1].ailments['神游']);});

success.name: 4865真实2050时空交错无减免无过量两段各1000固定伤害与对等回复，净HP状态真实；减免和HP不足明确待答且回合不提交
success.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空交错无减免无过量两段各1000固定伤害与对等回复，净HP状态真实；减免和HP不足明确待答且回合不提交',()=>{const s=make({move:29251,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),1000);const self=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.round===1&&e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===0&&e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(self[0].settledDamage,1000);assert.equal(self[0].hpLoss,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);for(const mode of['immune','reduced','overkill','self-immune']){const a=make({move:29251,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(a,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='reduced')timer(a,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='self-immune')timer(a,0,'固定百分比免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(a),/Q-4865-001/);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,mode==='overkill'?200:9000);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4865真实2050时空交错无减免无过量两段各1000固定伤害与对等回复，净HP状态真实；减免和HP不足明确待答且回合不提交',()=>{const s=make({move:29251,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),1000);const self=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.round===1&&e.sourceSide===0&&e.targetSide===0&&e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(self[0].settledDamage,1000);assert.equal(self[0].hpLoss,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);for(const mode of['immune','reduced','overkill','self-immune']){const a=make({move:29251,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(a,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='reduced')timer(a,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='self-immune')timer(a,0,'固定百分比免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(a),/Q-4865-001/);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,mode==='overkill'?200:9000);}});

interaction.name: 4865真实2050乱流当前对手已阵亡仍执行消逝，活对手不消逝；只把真实其他阵亡队列留第二阶段
interaction.assertion: test('4865真实2050乱流当前对手已阵亡仍执行消逝，活对手不消逝；只把真实其他阵亡队列留第二阶段',()=>{const s=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true,bStats:{maxHp:1000,atk:9999}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0&&c.t.hp>0)c.hurt(c.t,5000,'当前受击时反击的已结算输入','fixed');},()=>turn(s,10361,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,0);assert.ok(s.vanishEvents.some(e=>e.side===1));const alive=make({move:10361,index:-1,soul:true});turn(alive,10361,10127);assert.equal(alive.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,undefined);});

before.singleBehavior: 速度面板60%粉伤排除能力等级，实际用攻触发含MISS/整招无效；全技能次回起两回合先制独立累计；折跃实时已损60%实际魂印回复及等量粉、≤200神游和自清；交错首尾无减免无过量各1000固定伤害与1000回复验证，歧义路径Q001报错；反击后当前敌已阵亡按当前上限60%阈值消逝，低于阈值不消逝。
before.deferredBehavior: 时空乱流加入真实其他阵亡精灵上限之和并消逝全部真实阵亡队列；交错低于200时真实对手2回合无法主动换宠。
before.trigger: 实际敌方阵亡队列及主动换宠，不豁免当前已阵亡对手的消逝。
futureMechanisms: 真实阵亡队列与上限合计
全队列消逝
主动换宠资格/限时锁定

dependencyEvidence.quote: 对方阵亡精灵体力上限之和

after.reviewedBy: Codex exact current-field and explicit next-pet dependency review
after.rationale: 真实2050当前使用攻击的加速、战阶折跃、回末交错无歧义部分及当前敌已阵亡乱流已实现；只有真实其他阵亡队列和主动换宠流程延期。

success.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','floor','overkill']){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,51);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='immune'?0:500);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],mode==='immune');if(mode==='floor'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,500);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}const half=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:4500});turn(half);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(sum(half,'fixed'),0);});

failure.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','floor','overkill']){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,51);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='immune'?0:500);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],mode==='immune');if(mode==='floor'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,500);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}const half=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:4500});turn(half);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(sum(half,'fixed'),0);});

failure.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启',()=>{const s=rawMake({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000});assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),false);s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.type,'龙');assert.equal(c.a.hp,9000);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.count,0);for(const k of c.a.moves)assert.equal(c.a.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);checked=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058.length,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),500);const locked=rawMake({move:38272,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(locked),/有 PP/);assert.equal(locked.fighters[0].pp[key(38272)],1);});

boundary.assertion: test('4871 Q001两公式分歧/零概率/非整数与Q002带异常跨满额明确待答，整个回合不提交',()=>{for(const chance of[50,0,30]){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2,{resolvedProbabilityPercent:chance});},()=>turn(s)),/Q-4871-001/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(s)),/Q-4871-002/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,951);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,source.type);});

boundary.name: 4871真实3066受击50%成功失败都执行一次，转龙零结时两公式一致得100，监听未授前不计，RNG与无魂印对照一致
boundary.assertion: test('4871真实3066受击50%成功失败都执行一次，转龙零结时两公式一致得100，监听未授前不计，RNG与无魂印对照一致',()=>{const o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false,converted:true,own:[10018,29265,34462,29266,38272]},seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed,fast:true}),b=foreign({...o,seed,fast:true,observer:false});turn(a,10018,16076);turn(b,10018,16076);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,100);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058[0].chance,50);seen.add(!!a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);for(let i=0;i<2;i++){assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].pp,b.fighters[i].pp);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].ailments,b.fighters[i].ailments);}const early=foreign({...o,seed});turn(early,10018,16076);assert.equal(early.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,0);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);});

boundary.name: 4871真实3025原生389攻击20%从零得250且成功失败各一次，80%产生小数与初始1结公式分歧均不猜
boundary.assertion: test('4871真实3025原生389攻击20%从零得250且成功失败各一次，80%产生小数与初始1结公式分歧均不猜',()=>{const o={id:3025,ids:[24712,19239,24713,19240,19241],move:19239,strip:true,converted:true},seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed}),b=foreign({...o,seed,observer:false});turn(a,20065,19239);turn(b,20065,19239);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,250);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);seen.add(Object.keys(a.fighters[0].ailments).length>0);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].ailments,b.fighters[0].ailments);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);for(const [move,converted]of[[24712,true],[19239,false]]){const a=foreign({...o,move,converted});assert.throws(()=>turn(a,20065,move),/Q-4871-001/);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,converted?0:1);}});

boundary.name: 4871真实五星高热与火热特性8%从零得625，失败也计并清已有异常，观察不新增随机抽取
boundary.assertion: test('4871真实五星高热与火热特性8%从零得625，失败也计并清已有异常，观察不新增随机抽取',()=>{const o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false,strip:true,converted:true,own:[10018,29265,34462,29266,38272]};for(const group of[24,45]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed}),b=foreign({...o,seed,observer:false});for(const s of[a,b])s.fighters[1].build.characteristic=E.CHARACTERISTICS.normalize({groupId:group,star:5});turn(a,10018,16076);turn(b,10018,16076);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,625);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);seen.add(!!b.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}});

interaction.name: 4871真实2058战斗初1结在双方入场前，真实4822入场易燃执行后增51；4863自身与敌方沉默分别执行且不误跑回初
interaction.assertion: test('4871真实2058战斗初1结在双方入场前，真实4822入场易燃执行后增51；4863自身与敌方沉默分别执行且不误跑回初',()=>{for(const [id,want]of[[4822,51],[4863,101]]){const r=require('../data/species/'+id+'.json'),s=r.snapshot??r,ids=[...s.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth).slice(-4),s.moves.find(m=>m.fifth)].map(m=>m.id),a=foreign({id,ids});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,want);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,id===4822?1:2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.roundStartSoulResolved,undefined);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,undefined);for(const f of a.fighters)for(const k of f.moves)assert.equal(f.pp[k],a.moveDefinitions[k].pp);}});

interaction.name: 4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清
interaction.assertion: test('4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清',()=>{for(const [count,immune,want,cleared]of[[1,false,51,false],[450,false,500,false],[451,false,501,true],[451,true,501,true]]){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=count;if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;let seen=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const result=c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});assert.equal(result,!immune);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.wind2058.count,want);assert.equal(!!c.t.ailments['烧伤'],!immune&&!cleared);seen=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(seen,true);assert.equal(s.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,want);if(immune)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);}});

interaction.name: 4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印

interaction.name: 4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启

before.singleBehavior: 真实战初1结；100%执行及原零结非100%整数两公式等价分支计数，成功失败/免疫均执行后计；>500清异；低体50结与500固定理论吸取及零完整伤害焚烬；满额转龙与满HP/PP、龙属性天敌红减50%；高体预约下回初反转成功仅当回合固粉减50%。Q001/002/003路径明确报错不提交。
before.deferredBehavior: 回初预约反转未触发后，对手2回合无法主动切换精灵。
before.trigger: 回初预约反转未触发，真实主动切换行为。
futureMechanisms: 真实主动换宠资格
换宠锁定持续窗口

dependencyEvidence.quote: 对手2回合内无法主动切换精灵

after.reviewedBy: Codex exact source dependency and current-field state review
after.rationale: 风龙结、当前异常执行、延迟反转和减伤、低体吸取及焚烬均是当前双方分支，未知公式与反弹概率仍单精灵待答；只有原文无法主动切换精灵依赖换宠。

success.name: 4871真实2058战斗初1结在双方入场前，真实4822入场易燃执行后增51；4863自身与敌方沉默分别执行且不误跑回初
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058战斗初1结在双方入场前，真实4822入场易燃执行后增51；4863自身与敌方沉默分别执行且不误跑回初',()=>{for(const [id,want]of[[4822,51],[4863,101]]){const r=require('../data/species/'+id+'.json'),s=r.snapshot??r,ids=[...s.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth).slice(-4),s.moves.find(m=>m.fifth)].map(m=>m.id),a=foreign({id,ids});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,want);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,id===4822?1:2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.roundStartSoulResolved,undefined);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,undefined);for(const f of a.fighters)for(const k of f.moves)assert.equal(f.pp[k],a.moveDefinitions[k].pp);}});

success.name: 4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清',()=>{for(const [count,immune,want,cleared]of[[1,false,51,false],[450,false,500,false],[451,false,501,true],[451,true,501,true]]){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=count;if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;let seen=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const result=c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});assert.equal(result,!immune);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.wind2058.count,want);assert.equal(!!c.t.ailments['烧伤'],!immune&&!cleared);seen=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(seen,true);assert.equal(s.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,want);if(immune)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);}});

success.name: 4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','floor','overkill']){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,51);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='immune'?0:500);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],mode==='immune');if(mode==='floor'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,500);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}const half=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:4500});turn(half);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(sum(half,'fixed'),0);});

success.name: 4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启',()=>{const s=rawMake({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000});assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),false);s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.type,'龙');assert.equal(c.a.hp,9000);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.count,0);for(const k of c.a.moves)assert.equal(c.a.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);checked=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058.length,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),500);const locked=rawMake({move:38272,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(locked),/有 PP/);assert.equal(locked.fighters[0].pp[key(38272)],1);});

success.name: 4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减',()=>{for(const foeType of['龙','草']){const a=make({move:20065,soul:true}),b=make({move:20065});for(const s of[a,b]){s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type=foeType;}a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=1000;turn(a,20065,10127);turn(b,20065,10127);const hostile=E.typeEffectiveness(foeType,'龙',a.typeChart)>1;assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),hostile?Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)/2):sum(b,'attack',1));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1000);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058,undefined);}const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type='龙';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,300,'独立非红伤害',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,300);}},()=>turn(s));});

success.name: 4871真实2058高体回初预约下一回初反转，届时低体仍执行且仅当回合固粉减半，成功后不延续、失败留真实换宠延期
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058高体回初预约下一回初反转，届时低体仍执行且仅当回合固粉减半，成功后不延续、失败留真实换宠延期',()=>{const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,2);s.fighters[0].hp=4000;let reversed=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.t.stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.reductionRound,2);reversed=true;}if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const [type,n]of[['fixed',500],['percent',500],['true',1000]]){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'预约反转减伤交互',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,n);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(reversed,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,undefined);s.fighters[0].hp=9000;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'下一回合独立固定', 'fixed');assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,1000);}},()=>turn(s));const p=make({move:20065,soul:true});turn(p);timer(p,1,'强化保护');turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reductionRound,undefined);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.deferredSwitchLocks[0].implemented,false);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.deferredSwitchLocks[0].duration,2);});

success.name: 4871 Q001两公式分歧/零概率/非整数与Q002带异常跨满额明确待答，整个回合不提交
success.assertion: test('4871 Q001两公式分歧/零概率/非整数与Q002带异常跨满额明确待答，整个回合不提交',()=>{for(const chance of[50,0,30]){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2,{resolvedProbabilityPercent:chance});},()=>turn(s)),/Q-4871-001/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(s)),/Q-4871-002/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,951);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,source.type);});

success.name: 4871真实3066受击50%成功失败都执行一次，转龙零结时两公式一致得100，监听未授前不计，RNG与无魂印对照一致
success.assertion: test('4871真实3066受击50%成功失败都执行一次，转龙零结时两公式一致得100，监听未授前不计，RNG与无魂印对照一致',()=>{const o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false,converted:true,own:[10018,29265,34462,29266,38272]},seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed,fast:true}),b=foreign({...o,seed,fast:true,observer:false});turn(a,10018,16076);turn(b,10018,16076);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,100);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058[0].chance,50);seen.add(!!a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);for(let i=0;i<2;i++){assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].pp,b.fighters[i].pp);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].ailments,b.fighters[i].ailments);}const early=foreign({...o,seed});turn(early,10018,16076);assert.equal(early.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,0);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);});

success.name: 4871真实3025原生389攻击20%从零得250且成功失败各一次，80%产生小数与初始1结公式分歧均不猜
success.assertion: test('4871真实3025原生389攻击20%从零得250且成功失败各一次，80%产生小数与初始1结公式分歧均不猜',()=>{const o={id:3025,ids:[24712,19239,24713,19240,19241],move:19239,strip:true,converted:true},seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed}),b=foreign({...o,seed,observer:false});turn(a,20065,19239);turn(b,20065,19239);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,250);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);seen.add(Object.keys(a.fighters[0].ailments).length>0);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].ailments,b.fighters[0].ailments);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);for(const [move,converted]of[[24712,true],[19239,false]]){const a=foreign({...o,move,converted});assert.throws(()=>turn(a,20065,move),/Q-4871-001/);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,converted?0:1);}});

success.assertion: test('4871真实五星高热与火热特性8%从零得625，失败也计并清已有异常，观察不新增随机抽取',()=>{const o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false,strip:true,converted:true,own:[10018,29265,34462,29266,38272]};for(const group of[24,45]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed}),b=foreign({...o,seed,observer:false});for(const s of[a,b])s.fighters[1].build.characteristic=E.CHARACTERISTICS.normalize({groupId:group,star:5});turn(a,10018,16076);turn(b,10018,16076);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,625);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);seen.add(!!b.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}});

failure.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启',()=>{const s=rawMake({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000});assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),false);s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.type,'龙');assert.equal(c.a.hp,9000);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.count,0);for(const k of c.a.moves)assert.equal(c.a.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);checked=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058.length,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),500);const locked=rawMake({move:38272,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(locked),/有 PP/);assert.equal(locked.fighters[0].pp[key(38272)],1);});

failure.name: 4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减
failure.assertion: test('4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减',()=>{for(const foeType of['龙','草']){const a=make({move:20065,soul:true}),b=make({move:20065});for(const s of[a,b]){s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type=foeType;}a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=1000;turn(a,20065,10127);turn(b,20065,10127);const hostile=E.typeEffectiveness(foeType,'龙',a.typeChart)>1;assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),hostile?Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)/2):sum(b,'attack',1));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1000);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058,undefined);}const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type='龙';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,300,'独立非红伤害',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,300);}},()=>turn(s));});

failure.name: 4871真实2058高体回初预约下一回初反转，届时低体仍执行且仅当回合固粉减半，成功后不延续、失败留真实换宠延期

interaction.name: 4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印

success.name: 4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、16招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]矛盾执行拒绝且不提交
success.assertion: test('4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、16招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]矛盾执行拒绝且不提交',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));if(m.fifth){assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-4872-002/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else{turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4872 base '+m.id);}assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);});

success.name: 4872/2415/2416携带被动每项延长1回合，无需释放且双携不互换形态，实际完整伤害54%边界与单携转态
success.assertion: test('4872/2415/2416携带被动每项延长1回合，无需释放且双携不互换形态，实际完整伤害54%边界与单携转态',()=>{for(const carry of[[],[29267],[29268],[29267,29268]])for(const damage of[4859,4860]){const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load(carry)}),end=3+carry.length;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd,end);for(let r=1;r<=end;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,damage,'形态阈值真实固定伤害','fixed');},()=>turn(s));let want=damage<4860?'pale':'wrath';if(carry.length===1)want=carry[0]===29267?'wrath':'pale';assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,want);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,damage);for(const id of carry)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)],1);}});

success.name: 4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生目标Q001整回合不提交
success.assertion: test('4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生目标Q001整回合不提交',()=>{const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([]),hp:200});timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,5000,'保1完整结算','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);c.clear(c.t);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'wrath');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,5000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedHpLoss,199);const p=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([])});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');const before=structuredClone(p);assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/Q-4872-001/);assert.deepEqual(p,before);});

success.assertion: test('4872百天浮世络真实免弱反弹且不消费次数免异，复制对方真实最高星特性保留自身与源版本',()=>{const s=copyBattle('高热',{star:0,ownName:'坚硬'});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].build.characteristic.groupId,C.groups.find(x=>x.name==='坚硬').id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId,C.groups.find(x=>x.name==='高热').id);s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const before=c.t.stages.def;c.stage(c.t,-2,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,before);assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100}),false);}},()=>turn(s,20044));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});

success.name: 4872拒赦真实必暴、伤害翻倍且以混沌结算，怀生光结算不改技能原类型

success.assertion: test('4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置',()=>{const R=E.CHARACTERISTIC_RULES;for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆','坚硬',...C.groups.filter(x=>/^[\u4e00-\u9fff]+$/.test(x.name)&&C.get(x.id,5)?.description?.includes('属性技能威力增加')).map(x=>x.name)]){const s=copyBattle(name),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],row=C.get(C.groups.find(x=>x.name===name).id,5),compiled=R.compile(row);assert.equal(b.build.characteristic.star,0);if(name==='精准')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(a,b),1+compiled.fraction);else if(name==='回避')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(b,a),1-compiled.fraction);else if(name==='会心')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(a,b),compiled.fraction);else if(name==='免爆')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(b,a),-compiled.fraction);else if(compiled.kind==='power'){const move=s.moveDefinitions[key(10157)];assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:compiled.element},[compiled.element]),1+compiled.fraction);assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:'普通'},['普通']),compiled.element==='普通'?1+compiled.fraction:1);}}});

before.singleBehavior: 真实战初3回合百天浮世络，携带2415/2416各+1且决定形态替换；完整结算受伤54%阈值含保1零HP损失；免弱、免异反弹优先次数免异；独立额外复制敌通用特性最高星、概率99%、取消物特限制，保留自己原特性；慈悲光红伤、威怒混沌红伤+必暴/翻倍/先制；怀生实际随机对象Q001明确报错不提交。

before.trigger: 怀生随机弱化异常未触发及真实场下己方精灵。
futureMechanisms: 真实场下精灵HP与回复来源

dependencyEvidence.quote: 己方场下所有精灵恢复99点体力

after.reviewedBy: Codex source-explicit current-field versus real team dependency review
after.rationale: 百天浮世络与两后续形态、携带被动和额外通用特性属于当前自身强化；怀生随机异常对象Q001仍是单精灵待答，不能用场下回血延期豁免。

success.name: 4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、16招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]矛盾执行拒绝且不提交
success.assertion: test('4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、16招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]矛盾执行拒绝且不提交',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));if(m.fifth){assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-4872-002/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else{turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4872 base '+m.id);}assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);});

success.name: 4872/2415/2416携带被动每项延长1回合，无需释放且双携不互换形态，实际完整伤害54%边界与单携转态
success.assertion: test('4872/2415/2416携带被动每项延长1回合，无需释放且双携不互换形态，实际完整伤害54%边界与单携转态',()=>{for(const carry of[[],[29267],[29268],[29267,29268]])for(const damage of[4859,4860]){const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load(carry)}),end=3+carry.length;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd,end);for(let r=1;r<=end;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,damage,'形态阈值真实固定伤害','fixed');},()=>turn(s));let want=damage<4860?'pale':'wrath';if(carry.length===1)want=carry[0]===29267?'wrath':'pale';assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,want);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,damage);for(const id of carry)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)],1);}});

success.name: 4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生目标Q001整回合不提交
success.assertion: test('4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生目标Q001整回合不提交',()=>{const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([]),hp:200});timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,5000,'保1完整结算','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);c.clear(c.t);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'wrath');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,5000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedHpLoss,199);const p=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([])});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');const before=structuredClone(p);assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/Q-4872-001/);assert.deepEqual(p,before);});

success.name: 4872百天浮世络真实免弱反弹且不消费次数免异，复制对方真实最高星特性保留自身与源版本
success.assertion: test('4872百天浮世络真实免弱反弹且不消费次数免异，复制对方真实最高星特性保留自身与源版本',()=>{const s=copyBattle('高热',{star:0,ownName:'坚硬'});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].build.characteristic.groupId,C.groups.find(x=>x.name==='坚硬').id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId,C.groups.find(x=>x.name==='高热').id);s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const before=c.t.stages.def;c.stage(c.t,-2,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,before);assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100}),false);}},()=>turn(s,20044));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});

success.name: 4872拒赦真实必暴、伤害翻倍且以混沌结算，怀生光结算不改技能原类型
success.assertion: test('4872拒赦真实必暴、伤害翻倍且以混沌结算，怀生光结算不改技能原类型',()=>{for(const form of['pale','wrath']){const a=make({move:10629,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[10629,20044,38273,29270,38275]}),b=make({move:10629,index:-1});a.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form=form;a.fighters[1].type=b.fighters[1].type='光';let observed;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0){observed={affinity:c.affinity,stab:c.stab,modifier:c.modifier,crit:c.crit};if(form==='pale')c.a.soulId=null;}},()=>turn(a));turn(b);assert.equal(a.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].type,'光');assert.equal(observed.affinity,E.typeEffectiveness(form==='pale'?'光':'混沌','光',a.typeChart));assert.equal(observed.stab,E.sameTypeBonus(form==='pale'?'光':'混沌',a.fighters[0].type,a.typeChart));assert.equal(observed.crit,form==='wrath');if(form==='wrath'){assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*3.5);}}});

success.name: 4872复制五星火热和静电取消特殊物理限制，99%真实有成功失败；原生低星仍保留且状态时长与PP合法
success.assertion: test('4872复制五星火热和静电取消特殊物理限制，99%真实有成功失败；原生低星仍保留且状态时长与PP合法',()=>{for(const [name,kind,status]of[['火热','physical','烧伤'],['静电','special','麻痹'],['极寒','physical','冻伤'],['颤栗','special','害怕']]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=256;seed++){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind,seed,star:0});turn(s);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments[status]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(s.auditMoveId)],39-(kind==='special'?5:0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].build.characteristic.groupId,0);if(seen.size===2)break;}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}});

success.assertion: test('4872复制受击异常取消物理限定，受特殊攻击高热冰冷阴森带电均真实附给对手且免弱保护不抹掉特性',()=>{for(const [name,status]of[['高热','烧伤'],['冰冷','冻伤'],['阴森','害怕'],['带电','麻痹']]){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});turn(s,20044,10716);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments[status]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments[status],undefined);}});

success.name: 4872复制五种受特殊降级特性取消类型要求，敌物理攻击后真实降级；五种强化特性保留正确槽与五星幅度
success.assertion: test('4872复制五种受特殊降级特性取消类型要求，敌物理攻击后真实降级；五种强化特性保留正确槽与五星幅度',()=>{for(const [name,stat]of[['反抗','atk'],['反驳','def'],['忽略','spa'],['草率','spd'],['慌张','spe']]){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});turn(s,20044,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[stat],-1);}for(const [name,stat]of[['反击','atk'],['抵抗','def'],['反攻','spa'],['坚韧','spd'],['借风','spe']]){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});turn(s,20044,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[stat],stat==='def'?2:1);}});

success.name: 4872复制强攻强念取消物特限制，按真实五星定额附红；强袭精神按真实五星比例且类型放开
success.assertion: test('4872复制强攻强念取消物特限制，按真实五星定额附红；强袭精神按真实五星比例且类型放开',()=>{for(const [name,kind]of[['强攻','special'],['强念','physical'],['强袭','special'],['精神','physical']]){const a=copyBattle(name,{kind}),b=copyBattle(name,{kind});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(a);turn(b);const row=C.get(C.groups.find(g=>g.name===name).id,5);if(['强攻','强念'].includes(name)){const n=Number(row.description.match(/提高(\d+)点/)[1]);assert.equal(sum(a)-sum(b),n);}else{const f=1+Number(row.description.match(/([\d.]+)%/)[1])/100;assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*f));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*f));}}});

success.name: 4872复制坚硬/吸收/虚无/反弹真实改变HP或结算量，回血类与顽强触发使用真实五星参数
success.assertion: test('4872复制坚硬/吸收/虚无/反弹真实改变HP或结算量，回血类与顽强触发使用真实五星参数',()=>{for(const name of['坚硬','吸收','虚无','反弹']){const a=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(a,20044,10127);turn(b,20044,10127);if(name==='反弹')assert.ok(sum(a,'fixed')>0);else assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)<sum(b,'attack',1));}const heal=copyBattle('回神',{kind:'status'});heal.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(heal,20044,10127);assert.equal(heal.fighters[0].hp,9000);const endure=copyBattle('顽强',{kind:'status'});endure.fighters[0].hp=100;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,9999,'真实致命红伤','attack');},()=>turn(endure));assert.ok(endure.fighters[0].hp>0);});

success.name: 4872复制吸血按真实完整技能红伤回复，瞬杀99%真实击败；乱舞仍按现有用户确认白板且到期撤销复制
success.assertion: test('4872复制吸血按真实完整技能红伤回复，瞬杀99%真实击败；乱舞仍按现有用户确认白板且到期撤销复制',()=>{const s=copyBattle('吸血');s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>1000);const kill=copyBattle('瞬杀');turn(kill);assert.equal(kill.fighters[1].hp,0);const blank=copyBattle('乱舞'),base=copyBattle('乱舞');base.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(blank);turn(base);assert.equal(sum(blank),sum(base));assert.equal(blank.rng,base.rng);const exp=copyBattle('强攻',{kind:'special'});exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd=1;turn(exp);assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId,0);});

success.name: 4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置
success.assertion: test('4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置',()=>{const R=E.CHARACTERISTIC_RULES;for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆','坚硬',...C.groups.filter(x=>/^[\u4e00-\u9fff]+$/.test(x.name)&&C.get(x.id,5)?.description?.includes('属性技能威力增加')).map(x=>x.name)]){const s=copyBattle(name),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],row=C.get(C.groups.find(x=>x.name===name).id,5),compiled=R.compile(row);assert.equal(b.build.characteristic.star,0);if(name==='精准')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(a,b),1+compiled.fraction);else if(name==='回避')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(b,a),1-compiled.fraction);else if(name==='会心')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(a,b),compiled.fraction);else if(name==='免爆')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(b,a),-compiled.fraction);else if(compiled.kind==='power'){const move=s.moveDefinitions[key(10157)];assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:compiled.element},[compiled.element]),1+compiled.fraction);assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:'普通'},['普通']),compiled.element==='普通'?1+compiled.fraction:1);}}});

success.name: 4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖
success.assertion: test('4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖',()=>{for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆']){let changed=0;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;for(const s of[a,b]){s.criticals=name==='会心'||name==='免爆';if(name==='精准'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-1;}if(name==='回避')delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];}const crit=[];for(const s of[a,b]){let val;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===(name==='免爆'?1:0))val=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,name==='免爆'||name==='回避'?10127:20117));crit.push(val);}if(name==='精准'||name==='回避'){const side=name==='精准'?0:1,ar=sum(a,'attack',side)>0,br=sum(b,'attack',side)>0;if(name==='精准')assert.ok(!br||ar);else assert.ok(!ar||br);if(ar!==br)changed++;}else{if(name==='会心')assert.ok(!crit[1]||crit[0]);else assert.ok(!crit[0]||crit[1]);if(crit[0]!==crit[1])changed++;}}assert.ok(changed>0,name);}const a=copyBattle('免爆',{kind:'status'});timer(a,1,'必定暴击');let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===1)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(a,20044,10127));assert.equal(crit,true);});

success.assertion: test('4872复制十五种元素增威只在本精灵真实光招匹配时增威，其余系别不加成；原生特性与额外最高星独立保留',()=>{const rows=C.rows.filter(r=>r.star===5&&r.effectId===28);assert.equal(rows.length,15);for(const row of rows){const a=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'}),b=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;const type=row.description.match(/^(.+)属性技能/)[1],bonus=Number(row.description.match(/增加([\d.]+)%/)[1])/100;if(type==='光')b.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].power*=1+bonus;turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b),row.name);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);}const own=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',ownName:'坚硬',star:0}),copyOnly=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',star:0});own.fighters[1].stats.atk=copyOnly.fighters[1].stats.atk=1000;turn(own,20044,10127);turn(copyOnly,20044,10127);assert.ok(sum(own,'attack',1)<sum(copyOnly,'attack',1));});

boundary.assertion: test('4872复制吸血按真实完整技能红伤回复，瞬杀99%真实击败；乱舞仍按现有用户确认白板且到期撤销复制',()=>{const s=copyBattle('吸血');s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>1000);const kill=copyBattle('瞬杀');turn(kill);assert.equal(kill.fighters[1].hp,0);const blank=copyBattle('乱舞'),base=copyBattle('乱舞');base.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(blank);turn(base);assert.equal(sum(blank),sum(base));assert.equal(blank.rng,base.rng);const exp=copyBattle('强攻',{kind:'special'});exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd=1;turn(exp);assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId,0);});

boundary.name: 4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置
boundary.assertion: test('4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置',()=>{const R=E.CHARACTERISTIC_RULES;for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆','坚硬',...C.groups.filter(x=>/^[\u4e00-\u9fff]+$/.test(x.name)&&C.get(x.id,5)?.description?.includes('属性技能威力增加')).map(x=>x.name)]){const s=copyBattle(name),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],row=C.get(C.groups.find(x=>x.name===name).id,5),compiled=R.compile(row);assert.equal(b.build.characteristic.star,0);if(name==='精准')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(a,b),1+compiled.fraction);else if(name==='回避')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(b,a),1-compiled.fraction);else if(name==='会心')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(a,b),compiled.fraction);else if(name==='免爆')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(b,a),-compiled.fraction);else if(compiled.kind==='power'){const move=s.moveDefinitions[key(10157)];assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:compiled.element},[compiled.element]),1+compiled.fraction);assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:'普通'},['普通']),compiled.element==='普通'?1+compiled.fraction:1);}}});

boundary.name: 4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖
boundary.assertion: test('4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖',()=>{for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆']){let changed=0;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;for(const s of[a,b]){s.criticals=name==='会心'||name==='免爆';if(name==='精准'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-1;}if(name==='回避')delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];}const crit=[];for(const s of[a,b]){let val;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===(name==='免爆'?1:0))val=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,name==='免爆'||name==='回避'?10127:20117));crit.push(val);}if(name==='精准'||name==='回避'){const side=name==='精准'?0:1,ar=sum(a,'attack',side)>0,br=sum(b,'attack',side)>0;if(name==='精准')assert.ok(!br||ar);else assert.ok(!ar||br);if(ar!==br)changed++;}else{if(name==='会心')assert.ok(!crit[1]||crit[0]);else assert.ok(!crit[0]||crit[1]);if(crit[0]!==crit[1])changed++;}}assert.ok(changed>0,name);}const a=copyBattle('免爆',{kind:'status'});timer(a,1,'必定暴击');let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===1)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(a,20044,10127));assert.equal(crit,true);});

boundary.name: 4872复制十五种元素增威只在本精灵真实光招匹配时增威，其余系别不加成；原生特性与额外最高星独立保留
boundary.assertion: test('4872复制十五种元素增威只在本精灵真实光招匹配时增威，其余系别不加成；原生特性与额外最高星独立保留',()=>{const rows=C.rows.filter(r=>r.star===5&&r.effectId===28);assert.equal(rows.length,15);for(const row of rows){const a=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'}),b=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;const type=row.description.match(/^(.+)属性技能/)[1],bonus=Number(row.description.match(/增加([\d.]+)%/)[1])/100;if(type==='光')b.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].power*=1+bonus;turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b),row.name);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);}const own=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',ownName:'坚硬',star:0}),copyOnly=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',star:0});own.fighters[1].stats.atk=copyOnly.fighters[1].stats.atk=1000;turn(own,20044,10127);turn(copyOnly,20044,10127);assert.ok(sum(own,'attack',1)<sum(copyOnly,'attack',1));});

interaction.name: 4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、16招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]矛盾执行拒绝且不提交
interaction.assertion: test('4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、16招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]矛盾执行拒绝且不提交',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));if(m.fifth){assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-4872-002/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else{turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4872 base '+m.id);}assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);});

interaction.assertion: test('4872/2415/2416携带被动每项延长1回合，无需释放且双携不互换形态，实际完整伤害54%边界与单携转态',()=>{for(const carry of[[],[29267],[29268],[29267,29268]])for(const damage of[4859,4860]){const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load(carry)}),end=3+carry.length;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd,end);for(let r=1;r<=end;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,damage,'形态阈值真实固定伤害','fixed');},()=>turn(s));let want=damage<4860?'pale':'wrath';if(carry.length===1)want=carry[0]===29267?'wrath':'pale';assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,want);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,damage);for(const id of carry)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)],1);}});

interaction.name: 4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生目标Q001整回合不提交
interaction.assertion: test('4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生目标Q001整回合不提交',()=>{const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([]),hp:200});timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,5000,'保1完整结算','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);c.clear(c.t);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'wrath');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,5000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedHpLoss,199);const p=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([])});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');const before=structuredClone(p);assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/Q-4872-001/);assert.deepEqual(p,before);});

interaction.assertion: test('4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置',()=>{const R=E.CHARACTERISTIC_RULES;for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆','坚硬',...C.groups.filter(x=>/^[\u4e00-\u9fff]+$/.test(x.name)&&C.get(x.id,5)?.description?.includes('属性技能威力增加')).map(x=>x.name)]){const s=copyBattle(name),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],row=C.get(C.groups.find(x=>x.name===name).id,5),compiled=R.compile(row);assert.equal(b.build.characteristic.star,0);if(name==='精准')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(a,b),1+compiled.fraction);else if(name==='回避')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(b,a),1-compiled.fraction);else if(name==='会心')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(a,b),compiled.fraction);else if(name==='免爆')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(b,a),-compiled.fraction);else if(compiled.kind==='power'){const move=s.moveDefinitions[key(10157)];assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:compiled.element},[compiled.element]),1+compiled.fraction);assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:'普通'},['普通']),compiled.element==='普通'?1+compiled.fraction:1);}}});

interaction.name: 4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖
interaction.assertion: test('4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖',()=>{for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆']){let changed=0;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;for(const s of[a,b]){s.criticals=name==='会心'||name==='免爆';if(name==='精准'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-1;}if(name==='回避')delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];}const crit=[];for(const s of[a,b]){let val;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===(name==='免爆'?1:0))val=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,name==='免爆'||name==='回避'?10127:20117));crit.push(val);}if(name==='精准'||name==='回避'){const side=name==='精准'?0:1,ar=sum(a,'attack',side)>0,br=sum(b,'attack',side)>0;if(name==='精准')assert.ok(!br||ar);else assert.ok(!ar||br);if(ar!==br)changed++;}else{if(name==='会心')assert.ok(!crit[1]||crit[0]);else assert.ok(!crit[0]||crit[1]);if(crit[0]!==crit[1])changed++;}}assert.ok(changed>0,name);}const a=copyBattle('免爆',{kind:'status'});timer(a,1,'必定暴击');let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===1)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(a,20044,10127));assert.equal(crit,true);});

interaction.assertion: test('4872复制十五种元素增威只在本精灵真实光招匹配时增威，其余系别不加成；原生特性与额外最高星独立保留',()=>{const rows=C.rows.filter(r=>r.star===5&&r.effectId===28);assert.equal(rows.length,15);for(const row of rows){const a=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'}),b=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;const type=row.description.match(/^(.+)属性技能/)[1],bonus=Number(row.description.match(/增加([\d.]+)%/)[1])/100;if(type==='光')b.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].power*=1+bonus;turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b),row.name);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);}const own=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',ownName:'坚硬',star:0}),copyOnly=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',star:0});own.fighters[1].stats.atk=copyOnly.fighters[1].stats.atk=1000;turn(own,20044,10127);turn(copyOnly,20044,10127);assert.ok(sum(own,'attack',1)<sum(copyOnly,'attack',1));});

success.name: 4885全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与完整真实2071原生用招，魂印和技能ID分域，原魂印hash匹配
success.assertion: test('4885全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与完整真实2071原生用招，魂印和技能ID分域，原魂印hash匹配',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,2071);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4885 base '+m.id);}});

success.name: 4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害
success.assertion: test('4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','overkill','floor','full','skill-ban']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?100:mode==='floor'?1:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071;assert.equal(st.count,1);assert.equal(st.lostMaxHp,100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?8900:4000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.targetSide===0).length,0);if(mode==='floor'){const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,3000);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(s.fighters[1].hp>0)turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);}});

success.assertion: test('4885真实2071当前累计次数每次10%红增伤、每5次全技能优先1，首次灰鳞本次本体不提前增伤',()=>{for(const count of[0,1,4,5,10]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071,{count,firstAttackHere:true});turn(a);turn(b);const ratio=1+count*.1;assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*ratio));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*ratio));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,Math.floor(count/5));}const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);});

success.name: 4885真实2071首次致死翻倍次数、返还实际上限并魂印主动回复差值，先清中毒后保命；同回合1HP再受正伤仍完整记录而不再翻倍
success.assertion: test('4885真实2071首次致死翻倍次数、返还实际上限并魂印主动回复差值，先清中毒后保命；同回合1HP再受正伤仍完整记录而不再翻倍',()=>{const s=warm();s.fighters[0].hp=200;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,800,'第一次完整固定800','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);assert.equal(c.t.stats.maxHp,9000);assert.equal(c.t.ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.count,2);c.hurt(c.t,100,'当回合第二次完整真实100','true');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.count,2);}},()=>turn(s));const hits=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);assert.deepEqual(hits.map(e=>[e.settledDamage,e.hpLoss]),[[800,299],[100,0]]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.fatalEvents[0].healed,100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.noMoreMaxHpLoss,true);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,10,'下一回合致死','fixed');},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.fatalEvents.length,1);});

boundary.name: 4885真实2071免疫零结算不消费首次致死，首次0灰鳞条件不满足也已属于本场首次，不因其他保命存活再重试
boundary.assertion: test('4885真实2071免疫零结算不消费首次致死，首次0灰鳞条件不满足也已属于本场首次，不因其他保命存活再重试',()=>{const s=warm();s.fighters[0].hp=200;timer(s,0,'固定百分比免疫');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,800,'免疫归零','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.firstLethalSeen,false);delete c.t.effects['固定百分比免疫'];c.hurt(c.t,800,'免疫后真实致死','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.soulState.moth2071.count,2);}},()=>turn(s));const z=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:200,aStats:{spe:50}});timer(z,0,'致命保留',{hp:1},1,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,800,'零灰鳞首次致死','fixed');},()=>turn(z));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.firstLethalSeen,true);assert.equal(z.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);assert.equal(z.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);z.fighters[0].hp=200;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,800,'后续不得重试首次','fixed');},()=>turn(z));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(z.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);});

interaction.name: 4885全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与完整真实2071原生用招，魂印和技能ID分域，原魂印hash匹配

interaction.name: 4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害
interaction.assertion: test('4885真实2071首次攻击后灰鳞减最大HP100并记录实际减少，命中则最大HP三分一百分比理论吸取，满HP裁剪不是伤害',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','overkill','floor','full','skill-ban']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000,targetHp:mode==='overkill'?100:mode==='floor'?1:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071;assert.equal(st.count,1);assert.equal(st.lostMaxHp,100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8900);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?8900:4000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.targetSide===0).length,0);if(mode==='floor'){const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,3000);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(s.fighters[1].hp>0)turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2071.count,1);}});

before.deferredBehavior: 真实换宠离场后再次登场，重置每次在场首次攻击标记；本场累计次数和停止上限削减状态跨换宠保留。
before.trigger: 本人真实再次登场
futureMechanisms: 真实换宠/登场生命周期
跨在场累计状态保留

dependencyEvidence.quote: 每次在场首次攻击后触发灰鳞变

after.reviewedBy: Codex primary API exact source and battle-state verification
after.rationale: 每次在场首次攻击的当前首次、当前计数增伤/先制、首次致死均当前实现；仅真实离场后再次登场重置首次标记依赖换宠。准备累计次数前态验证所有当前数值分支，不冒充实现换宠。
after.singleBehavior: 首次攻击无论MISS/无效触发灰鳞，命中按公共理论百分比吸取；实际上限减少独立于伤害，累计次数当前增伤/先制。首次致死在完整伤害结算后翻倍、净异、返还实际差并魂印回复，当前回合保1且完整正伤事件保留。

success.assertion: test('4888全部17招有序实例编译；16招无魂印64种子基础与17招明确上回合0前态原生魂印执行，首回合2436及魂印明确待答',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=prepared({move:m.id,soul:true,history:[0]});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,1);if(m.id===38328){const first=make({move:m.id});assert.throws(()=>turn(first),/Q-4888-001/);}else require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4888 base '+m.id);}const s=make({move:38338,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-4888-001/);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2075].partial,true);assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);});

success.assertion:
test('4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立',()=>{for(const weak of[false,true]){const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true}),b=prepared({move:38338});const move=a.moveDefinitions[key(10716)],plain=b.moveDefinitions[key(10716)];if(weak){move.type='光';plain.type='光';}turn(a,38338,10716);turn(b,38338,10716);const hits=s=>s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);const ar=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='attack'),br=hits(b).find(e=>e.type==='attack');if(weak)assert.equal(ar.settledDamage,br.settledDamage);else{assert.ok(ar.settledDamage>=Math.floor(br.settledDamage*.7)-1);assert.ok(ar.settledDamage<=Math.ceil(br.settledDamage*.7)+1);}const fixed=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(fixed.settledDamage,weak?35:50);}
 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

success.assertion: test('4888真实2075回初有异改清敌能力提升，成功疲惫，强化保护或没有提升不触发，回初快照后新异不切换减伤',()=>{for(const mode of['success','none','protected']){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,38338,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,mode==='protected'?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],mode==='success');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart,false);}const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart,true);});

success.assertion: test('4888真实2075已有历史比较：提高先制回30%并下回合+1，降低只净异并+1，相等无奖励；与全部历史均不同时按回合数加30%红',()=>{for(const previous of[-1,0,1]){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,hp:1000,previousPriority:previous,history:[previous]});if(previous===1)s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;turn(s,38338,null);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075;assert.equal(st.nextPriorityRound,previous===0?undefined:3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,previous===-1?3700:1000);if(previous===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(st.nextDamageBoost,previous===0?0:.3);}const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,history:[-3,-3,-1]});turn(s,38338,null);assert.ok(Math.abs(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.nextDamageBoost-.9)<1e-9);});

test('4888真实2075登场公共异常链也观察对方进入附属；异常清除后再次进入算新事件，首个未打开按门序而非已开数量',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1)c.entryAilment(c.a,'星赐',2,c.a);}};let s;try{s=make({move:38338,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[0]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gateEvents[0].round,1);
 const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[1];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.clearAilments(c.a);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(a));assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[1,0,2]);});
