test('4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立',()=>{for(const weak of[false,true]){const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true}),b=prepared({move:38338});const move=a.moveDefinitions[key(10716)],plain=b.moveDefinitions[key(10716)];if(weak){move.type='光';plain.type='光';}turn(a,38338,10716);turn(b,38338,10716);const hits=s=>s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);const ar=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='attack'),br=hits(b).find(e=>e.type==='attack');if(weak)assert.equal(ar.settledDamage,br.settledDamage);else{assert.ok(ar.settledDamage>=Math.floor(br.settledDamage*.7)-1);assert.ok(ar.settledDamage<=Math.ceil(br.settledDamage*.7)+1);}const fixed=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(fixed.settledDamage,weak?35:50);}
 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

after.rationale: 当前本人在场时观察对方新进入附属异常依次开门及个人对应技能零PP选择均已实现，并验证真实双方瑞亚、登场异常链、重新进入。只有真实场下所有精灵、其他己方精灵和真实队伍共享的分支延期；首回合历史仍属单精灵Q001，未借延期豁免。
after.singleBehavior: 回初异常快照对应清强/成功疲惫或红伤30%减伤；微弱攻击改固定百分比30%；已知历史下比较实际先制给次回+1、魂印回血或净异、全部历史均不同则按回合数次回红增伤。本人当前观察对方每次实际新进入附属开首个未开门，只有对应个人技能选择使用不受PP值限制，不变成所有技能免耗。
after.deferredBehavior: 本人真实场下仍在出战背包时的跨精灵对方进入附属开队伍门；己方其他精灵附属使回末关闭首个未关闭门。天门为己方场下所有精灵回复1PP；地门回复场下等量体力；神门向对方场下所有精灵附加等量真实伤害。分别保留原始门术语及版本79e06234/d58a2bec/34b55dc3。
after.trigger: 对方真实进入附属异常、回末己方其他精灵附属、固定或百分比附加被免疫时针对真实场下目标

 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

failure.assertion:

 const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[1];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.clearAilments(c.a);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(a));assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[1,0,2]);});

boundary.assertion: test('4888全部17招有序实例编译；16招无魂印64种子基础与17招明确上回合0前态原生魂印执行，首回合2436及魂印明确待答',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=prepared({move:m.id,soul:true,history:[0]});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,1);if(m.id===38328){const first=make({move:m.id});assert.throws(()=>turn(first),/Q-4888-001/);}else require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4888 base '+m.id);}const s=make({move:38338,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-4888-001/);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2075].partial,true);assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);});

boundary.name: 4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立
boundary.assertion:
test('4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立',()=>{for(const weak of[false,true]){const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true}),b=prepared({move:38338});const move=a.moveDefinitions[key(10716)],plain=b.moveDefinitions[key(10716)];if(weak){move.type='光';plain.type='光';}turn(a,38338,10716);turn(b,38338,10716);const hits=s=>s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);const ar=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='attack'),br=hits(b).find(e=>e.type==='attack');if(weak)assert.equal(ar.settledDamage,br.settledDamage);else{assert.ok(ar.settledDamage>=Math.floor(br.settledDamage*.7)-1);assert.ok(ar.settledDamage<=Math.ceil(br.settledDamage*.7)+1);}const fixed=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(fixed.settledDamage,weak?35:50);}
 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

 const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[1];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.clearAilments(c.a);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(a));assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[1,0,2]);});

before.reviewedBy: Codex primary API direct-dependency split and battle-state tests
before.rationale: 当前全部音符按获得顺序消耗、强/中/弱三免疫、三层天在此及第三次秒杀、命运庇护当前真实抗性全部已知实现。只有API术语256/fd19d53c明示的下场保留需真实换宠；不因个人系统名称或源码缺口延期当前能力。
before.singleBehavior: 全部当前音符顺序消费；强音免下次攻击、中音次数免异独立来源、弱音仅实际秒杀通道消费；正确强弱中弱序列逐次获得三层天状态，第三次才秒杀；臣服/附属条件实际控制不扣PP；命运庇护仅配置异常抗性必触发而非全免。
before.deferredBehavior: 天依常在此获得命运庇护后，术语256/fd19d53c的真实下场保留与再次出场生命周期。其他跨成员所属方范围须在真实队伍阶段核对，不作为当前单体豁免。
before.trigger: 所有异常抗性必定触发，失去全免抗性，下场保留

success.name: 4895/2449错误顺序也逐音符消费但不获得天在此，三个强中弱当前免伤免异免秒分别真实触发，秒杀免疫不误挡普通真实伤害
success.assertion: test('4895/2449错误顺序也逐音符消费但不获得天在此，三个强中弱当前免伤免异免秒分别真实触发，秒杀免疫不误挡普通真实伤害',()=>{const s=prepareNotes(make({move:29328,index:0,loadout:[38359,29327,38354,38355,29328]}),[3,2,1]);turn(s,29328,null);assert.equal(score(s).heaven,0);assert.deepEqual(values(s),[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(score(s).executionImmunity.length,1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.t,false,false,2);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,100,'普通真实伤害','true');assert.equal(score({fighters:[c.t]}).executionImmunity.length,1);c.defeat(c.t,'测试真实秒杀',{instantKill:true});assert.ok(c.t.hp>0);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.score4895.executionImmunity.length,0);}},()=>turn(s,38359,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,0);});

success.name: 4895/2449同谱第一次天在此、第二次天曾在此、第三次天依常在此并仅该次秒杀，已有免秒可阻击败而状态升级保留
success.assertion: test('4895/2449同谱第一次天在此、第二次天曾在此、第三次天依常在此并仅该次秒杀，已有免秒可阻击败而状态升级保留',()=>{const s=make({move:29328,index:0,loadout:[38359,29327,38354,38355,29328]});for(let n=1;n<=3;n++){prepareNotes(s,[3,1,2,1]);if(n===3)s.fighters[1].soulState.score4895={notes:[],serial:0,heaven:0,heavenGains:0,events:[],weakDrains:[],ppRestoredTotal:0,executionImmunity:[{serial:1}]};turn(s,29328,null);assert.equal(score(s).heaven,n);assert.equal(score(s).heavenGains,n);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);}prepareNotes(s,[3,1,2,1]);s.fighters[0].pp[key(29328)]=3;turn(s,29328,null);assert.equal(score(s).heaven,3);assert.equal(score(s).heavenGains,4);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);const kill=make({move:29328,index:0});prepareNotes(kill,[3,1,2,1]);score(kill).heavenGains=2;score(kill).heaven=2;turn(kill,29328,null);assert.equal(kill.fighters[1].hp,0);});

success.name: 4895/2450获得、2448删除、2449消耗均须技能生效，整招无效不修改原音符；控制未用也不消费，零伤命中仍能施洗获得中音

dependencyEvidence.quote: 所有异常抗性必定触发，失去全免抗性，下场保留

before.reviewedBy: Codex primary API direct team-dependency split and state tests
before.rationale: 仅原文明示全队/唯一存活/主动换宠的条件或分支延期，当前个人信仰、伤害、回复、狂信、转移等全部已知分支状态测试；三个未确认单体定义仍明确阻塞，不以名称或引擎缺口豁免。
before.singleBehavior: 当前对手的信仰对象是自身时攻击红伤乘1.2、受到红伤乘.9；不是该对象不加减。对手当回合没有实际暴击时战斗阶段结束回复自身maxHP/4，技能禁疗不封魂印。暴击抵挡、改对象及免疫量附伤Q001/002仍是单体待答，没有延期豁免。
before.deferredBehavior: 真实其他对方队伍成员信仰自身时逐只+20%攻击伤害/-10%所受攻击伤害；回合开始真实对方全部成员均信仰自身时本场免异常、免能力下降、免固定、免百分比。
before.trigger: 对方每有1只精灵的信仰对象是自身；若对方的信仰对象均为自身

success.name: 4898真实2084当前对手信仰自身才增红20%与减红10%，固定百分比不机械改变
success.assertion: test('4898真实2084当前对手信仰自身才增红20%与减红10%，固定百分比不机械改变',()=>{const results=[];for(const faith of[undefined,0,1]){const s=make({move:11141,soul:true});(s.fighters[1].statusState??={}).faithSourceSide=faith;let outgoing,incoming;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)outgoing=c.modifier;if(e==='beforeIncomingAttack'&&c.a.side===0)incoming=c.reduction;},()=>turn(s,11141,10716));results.push({outgoing,incoming});assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);}assert.equal(results[1].outgoing,results[0].outgoing*1.2);assert.equal(results[2].outgoing,results[0].outgoing);assert.ok(Math.abs(results[1].incoming-.1)<1e-12);assert.equal(results[0].incoming,0);assert.equal(results[2].incoming,0);});

after.deferredBehavior: 真实其他对方队伍成员信仰自身时逐只+20%攻击伤害/-10%所受攻击伤害；回合开始真实对方全部成员均信仰自身时本场免异常、免能力下降、免固定、免百分比。

success.assertion: test('4898/1562真实狂信首次建立信仰对象并阻止对对象行动；清除异常不清对象，已有其他对象不覆盖',()=>{for(const previous of[undefined,1]){const s=make({move:29339,index:2});(s.fighters[1].statusState??={}).faithSourceSide=previous;turn(s,29339,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState?.faithSourceSide,previous??0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp['wiki:20117'],s.moveDefinitions['wiki:20117'].pp-(previous===1?1:0));assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['狂信']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pendingSwitchFaith4898.turns,2);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.clearAilments(c.t);},()=>turn(s,29339,null));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState?.faithSourceSide,previous??0);}});

before.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority direct dependency split and state tests
before.rationale: 首次出战的第一项红伤上限、当前高体弱化/未触发重授清异常、低体先制/威力、已知零红吸取、完整红伤阈值和未高红回末强化逐项真实验证。当前6次重触发截止、红上限单位、MISS零红资格与100%基数4个问题保持单体待答，不延期豁免。
before.singleBehavior: 当前首次出战次数1授2回合maxHP25%红伤上限，固定不受该上限；前五次真实重授不虚增出战次数；严格高/低于半体、逐项弱化实际成功、失败清异常、低体技能先制1及攻击威力倍、明确满体目标零红百分比吸取与理论魂印回复、单次完整红高于300吸取maxHP/3、当回合没有高红则战阶特攻速度各1。
before.deferredBehavior: 真实第二次及以后出战次数、依API出战次数依次触发等量的六项登场效果；真实多次出战重授/保留/过期与截止生命周期。当前不明的重新触发计数不算延期。
before.trigger: 自身登场时，根据本场战斗自身的出战次数，依次触发等量的下列效果

success.name: 4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{spd:1},bStats:{spa:9999},loadout:[20155,14102,20082,29352,38393]});turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),2250);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,2);turn(s,20155,20117);turn(s,20155,10716);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>2250);});

success.name: 4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常',()=>{for(const mode of['success','partial','immune']){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;if(mode==='partial'){s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;s.fighters[1].stages.spa=-6;}if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,mode==='immune'?2:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],mode!=='immune');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,mode==='immune'?0:-1);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,r+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,r+1);}assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,null),/Q-4903-001/);assert.equal(s.round,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,5);});

success.name: 4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500,4501]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp});let power;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(power,hp<4500?100:50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,hp<4500?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,hp>4500?-1:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断',()=>{for(const red of[300,301]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0){c.minimumDamage=red;c.minimumAfterReductions=true;}},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(sum(s),red);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),red>300?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,red>300?4000:1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,red>300?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,red>300?0:1);}const a=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1,aStats:{atk:9999}});turn(a,14102,20117);assert.ok(sum(a)>300);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,4000);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,0);});

success.assertion: test('4903真实2090已命中零红且目标满体时吸取100%共同明确9000百分比，免粉仍理论回复；技能命中封锁不封魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','pinkimmune','sealed']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='pinkimmune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='sealed')timer(s,0,'攻击技能命中效果失效');turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='pinkimmune'?0:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}const a=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1000});timer(a,1,'攻击伤害免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(a,14102,20117),/Q-4903-005/);assert.equal(a.round,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,1000);});

success.assertion: test('4903真实2090同回合第二次正红触及不同上限单位时Q002回滚，低总量重放不误阻塞',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{def:high?1:300,spd:high?1:300},bStats:{atk:high?9999:180,spa:high?9999:180}}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.m.id===key(10716))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));return r;}};try{if(high){assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,10716),/Q-4903-002/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500);}else{turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500-sum(s,'attack',1)-50);}}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}}});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常',()=>{for(const mode of['success','partial','immune']){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;if(mode==='partial'){s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;s.fighters[1].stages.spa=-6;}if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,mode==='immune'?2:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],mode!=='immune');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,mode==='immune'?0:-1);}});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,r+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,r+1);}assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,null),/Q-4903-001/);assert.equal(s.round,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,5);});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500,4501]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp});let power;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(power,hp<4500?100:50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,hp<4500?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,hp>4500?-1:0);}});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断',()=>{for(const red of[300,301]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0){c.minimumDamage=red;c.minimumAfterReductions=true;}},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(sum(s),red);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),red>300?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,red>300?4000:1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,red>300?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,red>300?0:1);}const a=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1,aStats:{atk:9999}});turn(a,14102,20117);assert.ok(sum(a)>300);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,4000);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,0);});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090已命中零红且目标满体时吸取100%共同明确9000百分比，免粉仍理论回复；技能命中封锁不封魂印
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090已命中零红且目标满体时吸取100%共同明确9000百分比，免粉仍理论回复；技能命中封锁不封魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','pinkimmune','sealed']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='pinkimmune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='sealed')timer(s,0,'攻击技能命中效果失效');turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='pinkimmune'?0:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}const a=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1000});timer(a,1,'攻击伤害免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(a,14102,20117),/Q-4903-005/);assert.equal(a.round,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,1000);});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090实际用出攻击MISS或整招无效低体Q004明确拒绝，控制未用不触发吸取，仍可未高红战阶强化
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际用出攻击MISS或整招无效低体Q004明确拒绝，控制未用不触发吸取，仍可未高红战阶强化',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='control'){turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);}else{assert.throws(()=>turn(s,14102,20117),/Q-4903-004/);assert.equal(s.round,1);}}});

interaction.name: 4903真实2090同回合第二次正红触及不同上限单位时Q002回滚，低总量重放不误阻塞
interaction.assertion: test('4903真实2090同回合第二次正红触及不同上限单位时Q002回滚，低总量重放不误阻塞',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{def:high?1:300,spd:high?1:300},bStats:{atk:high?9999:180,spa:high?9999:180}}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.m.id===key(10716))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));return r;}};try{if(high){assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,10716),/Q-4903-002/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500);}else{turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500-sum(s,'attack',1)-50);}}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}}});

依次触发等量的真实表项与已确认截止规则
六项真实时限、免暴、回复倍率、PP吸取与固粉增伤生命周期

dependencyEvidence.quote: 根据本场战斗自身的出战次数

after.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority direct dependency split and state tests
after.rationale: 首次出战的第一项红伤上限、当前高体弱化/未触发重授清异常、低体先制/威力、已知零红吸取、完整红伤阈值和未高红回末强化逐项真实验证。当前6次重触发截止、红上限单位、MISS零红资格与100%基数4个问题保持单体待答，不延期豁免。
after.singleBehavior: 当前首次出战次数1授2回合maxHP25%红伤上限，固定不受该上限；前五次真实重授不虚增出战次数；严格高/低于半体、逐项弱化实际成功、失败清异常、低体技能先制1及攻击威力倍、明确满体目标零红百分比吸取与理论魂印回复、单次完整红高于300吸取maxHP/3、当回合没有高红则战阶特攻速度各1。
after.deferredBehavior: 真实第二次及以后出战次数、依API出战次数依次触发等量的六项登场效果；真实多次出战重授/保留/过期与截止生命周期。当前不明的重新触发计数不算延期。

before.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority direct dependency split and state tests
before.rationale: 当前未击败才真实全弱，实际能力未下降才预约未来锁切；没有把当前异常或UI限制当真实换宠完成。

dependencyEvidence.quote: 对手2回合内无法主动切换精灵

before.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority personal source-bound state tests
before.rationale: 原版首用1项、强化首用2项，当前实际用招递增至六项及所有六种个人两回合增益均已实现。超过六候选仍单体待答，不以多精灵延期；只有本次在场计数在真实下场/重新出场时的生命周期依赖多精灵。
before.singleBehavior: 实际用出技能含MISS/整招无效，控制未用/药剂不递增；同招组件多红只递增一次。等概率无放回抽1至6项，本次必暴、封敌技能回复、无视强化、强化保护、30%/50%减伤、魂印战阶300/400回复均真实执行及到期。
before.deferredBehavior: 真实下场/重新登场后的本次在场触发项数重建、保留或清除，与真实换宠前后增益时限的生命周期。
before.trigger: 每次在场自身使用技能时；每次使用技能后触发的效果数量增加1条

success.name: 4905真实2092首次抽1项2106抽2项，逐次项数只加1且无重复，达到6后再用Q001明确回滚
success.assertion: test('4905真实2092首次抽1项2106抽2项，逐次项数只加1且无重复，达到6后再用Q001明确回滚',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});const initial=id===2106?2:1,uses=7-initial;for(let n=0;n<uses;n++){select([0,0,0,0,0,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905,event=st.events.at(-1);assert.equal(event.count,initial+n);assert.equal(event.selected.length,initial+n);assert.equal(new Set(event.selected).size,event.selected.length);assert.equal(st.usesHere,n+1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,initial+n+1);assert.equal(st.events.length,n+1);}const round=s.round,before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(20177)];assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20177,20117),/Q-4905-001/);assert.equal(s.round,round);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(20177)],before);}});

success.name: 4905真实原版六项各可被首次等概率选择，强化两项选择无重复且两源版本参数各保留
success.assertion: test('4905真实原版六项各可被首次等概率选择，强化两项选择无重复且两源版本参数各保留',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=V(2092).make({move:20177,soul:true,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,20177,20117);seen.add(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events[0].selected[0]);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[0,1,2,3,4,5]);for(let first=0;first<6;first++){const s=V(2106).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([(first+.1)/6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.events[0].selected[0],first);assert.notEqual(st.events[0].selected[0],st.events[0].selected[1]);assert.equal(st.sourceHash,'fabcd50e');}});

success.name: 4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true});let crit;select([0,0],()=>turn(a,10361,20117),(e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;});assert.equal(crit,true);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].effects['必定暴击'].end,2);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','potion']){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;select([0,0],()=>turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10361,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,mode==='control'||mode==='potion'?0:1);}}});

success.name: 4905真实两版免技能回血按来源，原已授禁疗不封血药和魂印来源回复，当前两回真实有效
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版免技能回血按来源，原已授禁疗不封血药和魂印来源回复，当前两回真实有效',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const mode of['skill','potion','soul']){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,targetHp:1000});select([.2,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['技能禁疗'].end,2);const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(mode==='soul'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.heal(c.a,100,'公开魂印来源回复验证','soul');}};try{turn(s,null,mode==='potion'?null:20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,mode==='potion'?1250:mode==='soul'?1100:1000);}});

success.name: 4905真实两版无视正强当前攻击不改对手原等级，强化保护真实阻清除反转吸取但不虚构免弱
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版无视正强当前攻击不改对手原等级，强化保护真实阻清除反转吸取但不虚构免弱',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true}),b=make({move:10361});a.fighters[1].stages.def=6;select([.4,.4],()=>turn(a,10361,20117));turn(b,10361,20117);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,6);const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});select([.6,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20309),(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.clearBoost(c.t),false);c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{atk:-1},'reverse');c.steal(c.a,c.t,'公开技能来源吸强');}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);}});

success.name: 4905真实原版减红30%强化50%含当前回合，固定50不减，与同条件无魂印实际伤害对照
success.assertion: test('4905真实原版减红30%强化50%含当前回合，固定50不减，与同条件无魂印实际伤害对照',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true}),b=make({move:20177});let reduction;select([.8,0],()=>turn(a,20177,10716),(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeIncomingAttack'&&c.a.side===0)reduction=c.reduction;});turn(b,20177,10716);const fraction=id===2106?.5:.3;assert.ok(Math.abs(reduction-fraction)<1e-12);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a,'attack',1)-Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)*(1-fraction)))<=1);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,9000-sum(a,'attack',1)-50);}});

success.name: 4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const half of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(half)timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});const amount=(id===2106?400:300)*(half?.5:1);select([.99,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(half?125:250)+2*amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+2*(half?125:250)+2*amount);}});

success.name: 4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项
success.assertion: test('4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,loadout:[10361,10211,20177,29355,38399]}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.id===key(10361))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10211)));return out;}};try{select([0,0],()=>turn(s,10361,20117));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events.length,1);}});

success.name: 4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支
success.assertion: test('4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

failure.assertion: test('4905真实两版使用时必暴当次攻击生效并维持两回，合法MISS和整招无效都递增一次，控制与药剂不递增',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const a=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true});let crit;select([0,0],()=>turn(a,10361,20117),(e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;});assert.equal(crit,true);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].effects['必定暴击'].end,2);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control','potion']){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;select([0,0],()=>turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10361,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,mode==='control'||mode==='potion'?0:1);}}});

dependencyEvidence.quote: 每次在场

after.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority personal source-bound state tests
after.rationale: 原版首用1项、强化首用2项，当前实际用招递增至六项及所有六种个人两回合增益均已实现。超过六候选仍单体待答，不以多精灵延期；只有本次在场计数在真实下场/重新出场时的生命周期依赖多精灵。
after.singleBehavior: 实际用出技能含MISS/整招无效，控制未用/药剂不递增；同招组件多红只递增一次。等概率无放回抽1至6项，本次必暴、封敌技能回复、无视强化、强化保护、30%/50%减伤、魂印战阶300/400回复均真实执行及到期。
after.deferredBehavior: 真实下场/重新登场后的本次在场触发项数重建、保留或清除，与真实换宠前后增益时限的生命周期。
after.trigger: 每次在场自身使用技能时；每次使用技能后触发的效果数量增加1条

dependencyEvidence.quote: 本次在场的触发项数+1

before.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority personal source-bound state tests
before.rationale: 原版首用1项、强化首用2项，当前实际用招递增至六项及所有六种个人两回合增益均已实现。超过六候选仍单体待答，不以多精灵延期；只有本次在场计数在真实下场/重新出场时的生命周期依赖多精灵。
before.singleBehavior: 实际用出技能含MISS/整招无效，控制未用/药剂不递增；同招组件多红只递增一次。等概率无放回抽1至6项，本次必暴、封敌技能回复、无视强化、强化保护、30%/50%减伤、魂印战阶300/400回复均真实执行及到期。
before.deferredBehavior: 真实下场/重新登场后的本次在场触发项数重建、保留或清除，与真实换宠前后增益时限的生命周期。
before.trigger: 每次在场自身使用技能时；每次使用技能后触发的效果数量增加1条

failure.name: 4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支
failure.assertion: test('4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

dependencyEvidence.quote: 每次在场

after.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority personal source-bound state tests
after.rationale: 原版首用1项、强化首用2项，当前实际用招递增至六项及所有六种个人两回合增益均已实现。超过六候选仍单体待答，不以多精灵延期；只有本次在场计数在真实下场/重新出场时的生命周期依赖多精灵。
after.singleBehavior: 实际用出技能含MISS/整招无效，控制未用/药剂不递增；同招组件多红只递增一次。等概率无放回抽1至6项，本次必暴、封敌技能回复、无视强化、强化保护、30%/50%减伤、魂印战阶300/400回复均真实执行及到期。
after.deferredBehavior: 真实下场/重新登场后的本次在场触发项数重建、保留或清除，与真实换宠前后增益时限的生命周期。
after.trigger: 每次在场自身使用技能时；每次使用技能后触发的效果数量增加1条

failure.name: 4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项
failure.assertion: test('4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,loadout:[10361,10211,20177,29355,38399]}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.id===key(10361))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10211)));return out;}};try{select([0,0],()=>turn(s,10361,20117));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events.length,1);}});

failure.name: 4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支
failure.assertion: test('4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

boundary.name: 4905真实2092首次抽1项2106抽2项，逐次项数只加1且无重复，达到6后再用Q001明确回滚
boundary.assertion: test('4905真实2092首次抽1项2106抽2项，逐次项数只加1且无重复，达到6后再用Q001明确回滚',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true});const initial=id===2106?2:1,uses=7-initial;for(let n=0;n<uses;n++){select([0,0,0,0,0,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905,event=st.events.at(-1);assert.equal(event.count,initial+n);assert.equal(event.selected.length,initial+n);assert.equal(new Set(event.selected).size,event.selected.length);assert.equal(st.usesHere,n+1);assert.equal(st.nextCount,initial+n+1);assert.equal(st.events.length,n+1);}const round=s.round,before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(20177)];assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20177,20117),/Q-4905-001/);assert.equal(s.round,round);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(20177)],before);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版战斗阶段回复300或400是魂印来源，技能禁疗不封，受普通回复倍率且当前和下一回合均执行',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const half of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:20177,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(half)timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});const amount=(id===2106?400:300)*(half?.5:1);select([.99,0],()=>turn(s,20177,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(half?125:250)+2*amount);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+2*(half?125:250)+2*amount);}});

interaction.name: 4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项
interaction.assertion: test('4905真实两版技能组件重放造成两次实际红伤但不重复使用魂印计数，beforeUse和afterUse不重复抽项',()=>{for(const id of[2092,2106]){const s=V(id).make({move:10361,soul:true,loadout:[10361,10211,20177,29355,38399]}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const out=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.id===key(10361))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10211)));return out;}};try{select([0,0],()=>turn(s,10361,20117));}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.usesHere,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905.events.length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支
interaction.assertion: test('4905全部17招各64种子基础实际PP/HP，两版2092/2106各17招首次原生魂印真实分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2092,2106])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.sisy4905;assert.equal(st.usesHere,1);assert.equal(st.events[0].selected.length,id===2106?2:1);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

before.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority current-personal dependency split and state tests
before.rationale: 原2095与强化2107的当前在场首用攻击必暴、打出前清强清回合、双方实际暴击事件计数、指定时长转换、最大体力差魂印回复及等次数下一回合全技能先制全部已知分支真实验证。多段计数单位保持单体待答，不延期。
before.singleBehavior: 控制/药剂不消费首用攻击，MISS已使用消费但未打出暴击，打出前每回战阶清强成功才清回合；真实暴击含命中零红。高于转换已有全部异常1/2回合焚烬，低于按双方实际最大体力差回复，等于下一回全技能先制1/3，与技能+2相加。
before.deferredBehavior: 实际换入换出后的本次在场首次攻击使用机会、首次打出状态及双方暴击次数统计生命周期。当前多段统计歧义不属于队伍延期。
before.trigger: 每次在场自身首次使用攻击技能；战斗阶段结束比较本次在场致命一击次数

after.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority current-personal dependency split and state tests
after.rationale: 原2095与强化2107的当前在场首用攻击必暴、打出前清强清回合、双方实际暴击事件计数、指定时长转换、最大体力差魂印回复及等次数下一回合全技能先制全部已知分支真实验证。多段计数单位保持单体待答，不延期。
after.singleBehavior: 控制/药剂不消费首用攻击，MISS已使用消费但未打出暴击，打出前每回战阶清强成功才清回合；真实暴击含命中零红。高于转换已有全部异常1/2回合焚烬，低于按双方实际最大体力差回复，等于下一回全技能先制1/3，与技能+2相加。
after.deferredBehavior: 实际换入换出后的本次在场首次攻击使用机会、首次打出状态及双方暴击次数统计生命周期。当前多段统计歧义不属于队伍延期。
after.trigger: 每次在场自身首次使用攻击技能；战斗阶段结束比较本次在场致命一击次数

dependencyEvidence.quote: 每次在场

before.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority current-personal dependency split and state tests
before.rationale: 原2095与强化2107的当前在场首用攻击必暴、打出前清强清回合、双方实际暴击事件计数、指定时长转换、最大体力差魂印回复及等次数下一回合全技能先制全部已知分支真实验证。多段计数单位保持单体待答，不延期。
before.singleBehavior: 控制/药剂不消费首用攻击，MISS已使用消费但未打出暴击，打出前每回战阶清强成功才清回合；真实暴击含命中零红。高于转换已有全部异常1/2回合焚烬，低于按双方实际最大体力差回复，等于下一回全技能先制1/3，与技能+2相加。
before.deferredBehavior: 实际换入换出后的本次在场首次攻击使用机会、首次打出状态及双方暴击次数统计生命周期。当前多段统计歧义不属于队伍延期。
before.trigger: 每次在场自身首次使用攻击技能；战斗阶段结束比较本次在场致命一击次数

success.assertion: test('4908已命中零红暴击沿用4755和4766已确认计为真实暴击；同次两个组件暴击计次明确拒绝',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.ownCrit,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908.firstCrit,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);const p=make({move:10086,soul:true,loadout:[10086,20030,29362,38411,29364]});const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(phase,ops,c){const x=old.run(phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10086)));return x;}};try{assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/Q-4908-003/);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(p.round,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10086)],35);});

success.assertion: test('4908全部16招各64种子真实基础PP/HP及原2095强化2107各16招首次原生魂印当前分支',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.effectIds.includes(87)?m.pp:before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2095,2107])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});turn(s,m.id,20309);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.rebel4908;assert.equal(st.firstAttackUsed,m.kind!=='status');assert.equal(st.ownCrit,m.kind!=='status'?1:0);assert.equal(st.foeCrit,0);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

dependencyEvidence.quote: 每次在场

after.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority current-personal dependency split and state tests
after.rationale: 原2095与强化2107的当前在场首用攻击必暴、打出前清强清回合、双方实际暴击事件计数、指定时长转换、最大体力差魂印回复及等次数下一回合全技能先制全部已知分支真实验证。多段计数单位保持单体待答，不延期。
after.singleBehavior: 控制/药剂不消费首用攻击，MISS已使用消费但未打出暴击，打出前每回战阶清强成功才清回合；真实暴击含命中零红。高于转换已有全部异常1/2回合焚烬，低于按双方实际最大体力差回复，等于下一回全技能先制1/3，与技能+2相加。
after.deferredBehavior: 实际换入换出后的本次在场首次攻击使用机会、首次打出状态及双方暴击次数统计生命周期。当前多段统计歧义不属于队伍延期。
after.trigger: 每次在场自身首次使用攻击技能；战斗阶段结束比较本次在场致命一击次数

success.assertion: test('4911全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP，2097原生17种原选择首轮转化真实第五、按原槽消耗且首次冰封',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);if(!m.fifth)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.knownCommonFirst,true);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

interaction.name: 4911真实2097决斗控制未用与药剂保留下次转化，整招无效实际使用消费；无可选第五阻止技能且不扣原槽PP
interaction.assertion: test('4911真实2097决斗控制未用与药剂保留下次转化，整招无效实际使用消费；无可选第五阻止技能且不扣原槽PP',()=>{for(const mode of['control','potion','invalid','zeroFifth']){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='zeroFifth')s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)]=0;turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext,mode!=='invalid');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],mode==='invalid'?34:35);if(mode==='zeroFifth')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],0);}});

interaction.name: 4911真实2097高体回合开始全一及所有PP加4上限，不以第五后续清回合强化冒充回合开始；相等两分支均不触发
interaction.assertion: test('4911真实2097高体回合开始全一及所有PP加4上限，不以第五后续清回合强化冒充回合开始；相等两分支均不触发',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,targetHp:high?8999:9000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0)captured={stages:{...c.a.stages},pp:{...c.a.pp},snap:{...c.a.soulState.starlight4911}};},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));for(const k of keys)assert.equal(captured.stages[k],high?1:0);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],high?Math.min(5,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp):1);assert.equal(captured.snap.high,high);assert.equal(captured.snap.low,false);}});

interaction.name: 4911真实2097低体按回合开始快照全技先制1并无视敌双防正强，面板相同时实际红伤一致
interaction.assertion: test('4911真实2097低体按回合开始快照全技先制1并无视敌双防正强，面板相同时实际红伤一致',()=>{const enemySource=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4909/snapshot.json'),opts={move:10001,soul:true,hp:8999,enemySource,enemyLoadout:[38414,10086,29365,29366,38413]},a=make(opts),b=make(opts);a.fighters[1].stages.def=6;a.fighters[1].stages.spd=6;turn(a,10001,10086);turn(b,10001,10086);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.starlight4911.low,true);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));assert.ok(sum(a)>0);});

interaction.name: 4911真实决斗当前死亡转落败且解除对手决斗，自身落败4回记录、公共被击败反制被抑制，不凭单挑推断最后存活保1
interaction.assertion: test('4911真实决斗当前死亡转落败且解除对手决斗，自身落败4回记录、公共被击败反制被抑制，不凭单挑推断最后存活保1',()=>{for(const dead of[0,1]){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:dead===0?1:9000,targetHp:dead===1?1:9000});timer(s,dead,'被击败疲惫对手',{duration:3});turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].soulState.knightDuel4911.kind,'defeat');assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].soulState.defeatEffectsSuppressed,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1-dead].soulState.knightDuel4911,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1-dead].ailments['疲惫'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[dead].soulState.knightDuel4911.end,dead===0?4:undefined);}});

interaction.name: 4911当前即时2243重生发生在实际死亡前不转骑士落败、不消除对手决斗
interaction.assertion: test('4911当前即时2243重生发生在实际死亡前不转骑士落败、不消除对手决斗',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:1});s.fighters[0].soulState.rebirth2243={armed:true};turn(s,10001,20309);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.kind,'duel');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.knightDuel4911.kind,'duel');assert.notEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.defeatEffectsSuppressed,true);});

interaction.name: 4911全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP，2097原生17种原选择首轮转化真实第五、按原槽消耗且首次冰封
interaction.assertion: test('4911全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP，2097原生17种原选择首轮转化真实第五、按原槽消耗且首次冰封',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);if(!m.fifth)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38419)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightDuel4911.transformNext,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.knightIce2505.knownCommonFirst,true);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封']);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

before.singleBehavior: 首次实际攻击获得1层并按对手maxHP/3百分比理论魂印回复；对手首次实际攻击本回减伤半，微弱时下一次属性无效；每层红伤10%每5层先制1，默认上限5。当前成功致死主动恢复全部体力、全部层转海、清异常负级、源计免攻1及上限0。海冻结当前双方烧伤时长且实际死亡消逝。

success.name: 4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','status','potion','control','miss','redimmune']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}if(mode==='redimmune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,mode==='status'?20182:mode==='potion'?null:10086,20309);const yes=['hit','miss','redimmune'].includes(mode);assert.equal(st(s).embers,yes?1:0);assert.equal(st(s).ownFirst,yes);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),yes?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,yes?4000:mode==='potion'?1250:1000);}});

success.name: 4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(s,10086,20309);turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);for(const n of[1,5]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(st(a),{embers:n,ownFirst:true});turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n===5?1:0);}const cap=make({move:10086,soul:true});st(cap).embers=5;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,5);st(cap).embers=0;st(cap).capZero=true;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,0);});

success.name: 4912真实2099对手首次实际攻击本回红伤减半、后续不减，弱属性时源计次封下一次属性且保留异源
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099对手首次实际攻击本回红伤减半、后续不减，弱属性时源计次封下一次属性且保留异源',()=>{const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});turn(a,10086,10127);turn(b,10086,10127);assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)>=Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)*.5));assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)<=Math.ceil(sum(b,'attack',1)*.5));turn(a,10086,10127);turn(b,10086,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),sum(b,'attack',1));const weak=make({move:10086,soul:true,enemySource:require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4908/snapshot.json'),enemyLoadout:[11961,20030,29362,38411,29364]});weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid=2;turn(weak,10086,11961);assert.equal(st(weak).events.find(e=>e.kind==='foe-first').weak,true);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid,3);const speed=weak.fighters[1].stages.spe;turn(weak,10086,20030);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid,2);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].stages.spe,speed);});

success.name: 4912真实2099成功致死魂印主动回满消耗全部已备渐烬、解除异常负级、授源免攻1、天海等层及上限0，技能禁疗不封锁
success.assertion: test('4912真实2099成功致死魂印主动回满消耗全部已备渐烬、解除异常负级、授源免攻1、天海等层及上限0，技能禁疗不封锁',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999},loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);s.fighters[0].hp=1;s.fighters[0].stages.spa=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,true);assert.equal(st(s).sea,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.deathResolved,undefined);const loss=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.round===2&&e.type==='attack'&&e.targetSide===0);assert.ok(loss.settledDamage>9000);assert.equal(loss.hpLoss,1);turn(s,20182,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,0);turn(s,20182,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.vanished,true);assert.ok(s.vanishEvents.some(e=>Number(e.species)===4912));});

success.name: 4912天烬海当前双方烧伤每回合数不减少、其他异常正常到期且烧伤实际持续扣HP，双来源海不重复延长

boundary.name: 4912免疫拓时点、主动恢复失败和并存保命重生明确当前待答并回滚，不吞未实现行为
boundary.assertion: test('4912免疫拓时点、主动恢复失败和并存保命重生明确当前待答并回滚，不吞未实现行为',()=>{for(const mode of['immune','heal-fail','floor','rebirth']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});Object.assign(st(s),{embers:1,ownFirst:mode!=='immune'});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='heal-fail')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:1});if(mode==='floor')timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='rebirth')s.fighters[0].soulState.rebirth2243={armed:true};const before=structuredClone(s);assert.throws(()=>turn(s,10086,10127),mode==='immune'?/Q-4912-001/:mode==='heal-fail'?/Q-4912-002/:/Q-4912-003/);assert.deepEqual(s,before);}});

boundary.name: 4912全部17招各64种子真实HP和PP，原生2099全部17招首轮执行与火系消费
boundary.assertion: test('4912全部17招各64种子真实HP和PP，原生2099全部17招首轮执行与火系消费',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.ownFirst,['physical','special'].includes(m.kind));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,m.fifth?'虫':source.type);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

interaction.name: 4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用
interaction.assertion: test('4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','status','potion','control','miss','redimmune']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}if(mode==='redimmune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,mode==='status'?20182:mode==='potion'?null:10086,20309);const yes=['hit','miss','redimmune'].includes(mode);assert.equal(st(s).embers,yes?1:0);assert.equal(st(s).ownFirst,yes);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),yes?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,yes?4000:mode==='potion'?1250:1000);}});

interaction.name: 4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限
interaction.assertion: test('4912真实2099普通不免疫首次后不重复，渐烬每层红伤10%与每5层全技能先制1，5层基底上限与0上限',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(s,10086,20309);turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);for(const n of[1,5]){const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});Object.assign(st(a),{embers:n,ownFirst:true});turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*(1+.1*n)));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,n===5?1:0);}const cap=make({move:10086,soul:true});st(cap).embers=5;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,5);st(cap).embers=0;st(cap).capZero=true;assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2099].abilities.gain({a:cap.fighters[0],round:1}),0);assert.equal(st(cap).embers,0);});

interaction.name: 4912真实2099对手首次实际攻击本回红伤减半、后续不减，弱属性时源计次封下一次属性且保留异源
interaction.assertion: test('4912真实2099对手首次实际攻击本回红伤减半、后续不减，弱属性时源计次封下一次属性且保留异源',()=>{const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086});turn(a,10086,10127);turn(b,10086,10127);assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)>=Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)*.5));assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)<=Math.ceil(sum(b,'attack',1)*.5));turn(a,10086,10127);turn(b,10086,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),sum(b,'attack',1));const weak=make({move:10086,soul:true,enemySource:require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4908/snapshot.json'),enemyLoadout:[11961,20030,29362,38411,29364]});weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid=2;turn(weak,10086,11961);assert.equal(st(weak).events.find(e=>e.kind==='foe-first').weak,true);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid,3);const speed=weak.fighters[1].stages.spe;turn(weak,10086,20030);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid,2);assert.equal(weak.fighters[1].stages.spe,speed);});

interaction.name: 4912真实2099成功致死魂印主动回满消耗全部已备渐烬、解除异常负级、授源免攻1、天海等层及上限0，技能禁疗不封锁
interaction.assertion: test('4912真实2099成功致死魂印主动回满消耗全部已备渐烬、解除异常负级、授源免攻1、天海等层及上限0，技能禁疗不封锁',()=>{const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999},loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(st(s).embers,1);s.fighters[0].hp=1;s.fighters[0].stages.spa=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,10086,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(st(s).embers,0);assert.equal(st(s).capZero,true);assert.equal(st(s).sea,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.deathResolved,undefined);const loss=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.round===2&&e.type==='attack'&&e.targetSide===0);assert.ok(loss.settledDamage>9000);assert.equal(loss.hpLoss,1);turn(s,20182,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,0);turn(s,20182,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.vanished,true);assert.ok(s.vanishEvents.some(e=>Number(e.species)===4912));});

interaction.name: 4912天烬海当前双方烧伤每回合数不减少、其他异常正常到期且烧伤实际持续扣HP，双来源海不重复延长
interaction.assertion: test('4912天烬海当前双方烧伤每回合数不减少、其他异常正常到期且烧伤实际持续扣HP，双来源海不重复延长',()=>{const s=make({move:20182,soul:true});st(s).sea=1;s.fighters[1].soulState.moth2099={sea:2};for(const f of s.fighters){f.ailments['烧伤']=2;f.ailments['中毒']=2;}let last=9000;for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,20182,20309);for(const f of s.fighters)assert.equal(f.ailments['烧伤']-s.round+1,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp<last);last=s.fighters[0].hp;if(r>=2)for(const f of s.fighters)assert.equal(f.ailments['中毒'],undefined);}assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>f.hp>0));});

after.rationale: 当前渐烬、首次攻击与减伤、成功致死回复、烧伤冻结及真实死亡消逝均已验证。当前免疫拓时点、失败回复、保命并存等歧义单独待答，不延期。
after.singleBehavior: 首次实际攻击获得1层并按对手maxHP/3百分比理论魂印回复；对手首次实际攻击本回减伤半，微弱时下一次属性无效；每层红伤10%每5层先制1，默认上限5。当前成功致死主动恢复全部体力、全部层转海、清异常负级、源计免攻1及上限0。海冻结当前双方烧伤时长且实际死亡消逝。
after.deferredBehavior: 真实重新登场的双方首次机会；渐烬上限按双方真实阵亡精灵数每只加5；己方天烬海队伍共享与跨离场保留，灰蛾不在场每回合减1层。
after.trigger: 每次在场；双方每有1只精灵阵亡；己方获得天烬海且灰蛾不在场
futureMechanisms: 真实换宠和首次机会生命周期
双方真实阵亡数量
己方共享天烬海跨场及场下递减

boundary.assertion: test('4912全部17招各64种子真实HP和PP，原生2099全部17招首轮执行与火系消费',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.moth2099.ownFirst,['physical','special'].includes(m.kind));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,m.fifth?'虫':source.type);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}});

interaction.name: 4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用
interaction.assertion: test('4912真实2099首次实际攻击得1渐烬并最大HP三分一百分比吸取理论魂印回复，属性/血药/控制不消费，MISS和红免疫仍属使用',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','status','potion','control','miss','redimmune']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[10086,20182,29372,29373,38426]});if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});}if(mode==='redimmune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,mode==='status'?20182:mode==='potion'?null:10086,20309);const yes=['hit','miss','redimmune'].includes(mode);assert.equal(st(s).embers,yes?1:0);assert.equal(st(s).ownFirst,yes);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),yes?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,yes?4000:mode==='potion'?1250:1000);}});

after.rationale: 两真实魂印分别保留哈希和参数，当前记录无冲突、匹配命中及未触发凝滞、全记录清理、敌异常特攻速度提升、次轮面板百分比及无敌异常回血和强化先制均独立验证。重生及记录歧义仍是自身待答，不延期。
after.singleBehavior: 初始事象观测填缺省记录，首轮双来源无冲突的记录、技能命中匹配附加异常否则凝滞；两项明确成功回末清异常；战斗阶段结束敌有异常特攻速度+1、次轮面板特攻40%或60%，否则魂印恢复四分一或三分一及强化先制1。
after.deferredBehavior: 真实重新登场时记录条件重建及跨下场记录保留，按当前待答确定后的真实生命周期实现。
after.trigger: 自身登场之后
futureMechanisms: 真实再次登场记录生命周期

interaction.name: 4915全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP，两版魂印17招首轮同类型与免异分支，三招记录冲突显式回滚
interaction.assertion: test('4915全部17招各64种子真实HP/PP，两版魂印17招首轮同类型与免异分支，三招记录冲突显式回滚',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38432?Math.min(m.pp,pp+1):pp-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),before=structuredClone(s),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);assert.throws(()=>H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716),/Q-4915-002/);assert.deepEqual(s,before);}}});

before.singleBehavior: 初始事象观测填缺省记录，首轮双来源无冲突的记录、技能命中匹配附加异常否则凝滞；两项明确成功回末清异常；战斗阶段结束敌有异常特攻速度+1、次轮面板特攻40%或60%，否则魂印恢复四分一或三分一及强化先制1。
before.deferredBehavior: 真实重新登场时记录条件重建及跨下场记录保留，按当前待答确定后的真实生命周期实现。

after.rationale: 初始20%最大HP转换与五项面板等量增、转换后记录值、三个有序抗性槽实际进入奖励在正常行动和登场阶段均验证。回血计次、溢出与最优系别范围明确当前待答并在完整回合回滚，不用多精灵延期豁免。
after.singleBehavior: 开局最大HP减20%，五项面板增同量，记录新maxHP。成功新进入第1槽状态回满所有PP，第2槽封敌次轮属性，第3槽封敌次轮攻击；免疫和同名持续刷新不重复触发。第三槽概率由显式实验配置提供，不伪称查得默认值。
after.deferredBehavior: 真正后续登场时依据已记录maxHP判定并转换对手上限及其它面板；临时体力上限按API536在真正下场时消失。当前临时上限数值链仍待答，不延期。
after.trigger: 之后本场战斗自身登场时；临时体力上限默认下场消失
futureMechanisms: 真实再次登场与当前对手
真实离场清临时最大体力

success.assertion: test('4921真实初始20%体力上限转五项面板等量、记录转换后上限，不伪造对手再次登场',()=>{for(const maxHp of[5000,9000]){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp}}),f=s.fighters[0],cost=maxHp*.2;assert.equal(f.stats.maxHp,maxHp-cost);assert.equal(f.hp,maxHp-cost);for(const[k,n]of Object.entries({atk:180,spa:180,def:300,spd:300,spe:500}))assert.equal(f.stats[k],n+cost);assert.equal(f.soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,maxHp-cost);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.atk,180);}});

success.name: 4921三个真实有序抗性槽成功进入分别回满PP、次轮封属性、次轮封攻击，失败及重复刷新不触发
success.assertion: test('4921三个真实有序抗性槽成功进入分别回满PP、次轮封属性、次轮封攻击，失败及重复刷新不触发',()=>{for(const slot of[0,1,2])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true,loadout:[10047,22660,29390,29391,38452]});s.fighters[0].build.resistance=E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({slots:[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤',chance:0}]});const names=['中毒','烧伤','冻伤'];s.fighters[0].pp[key(22660)]=0;if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,names[slot],c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,immune?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(22660)],!immune&&slot===0?source.moves.find(m=>m.id===22660).pp:0);if(!immune&&slot>0){const block=slot===1?'statusBlock':'attackBlock';assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].effects[block],{start:2,end:2});const move=slot===1?20117:10127,pp=s.fighters[1].pp[key(move)];isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,names[slot],c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,move));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(move)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,1);}}});

success.name: 4923真实2119初始四蜃楼，四个实装技能顺序的真实异常转超频与逐双向延长
success.assertion: test('4923真实2119初始四蜃楼，四个实装技能顺序的真实异常转超频与逐双向延长',()=>{const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});resistance(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,29398,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119;assert.deepEqual(st.cities.map(x=>x.name),['序','源','逐','理'].slice(0,r));assert.equal(st.remaining,4-r);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],r+2);}observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'凝滞',c.t,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.t,'凝滞',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(s,38460,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],7);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['凝滞'],7);});

success.assertion: test('4923真实2119异常免疫/抗性成功不转楼，非控制抗性与无槽不转；非四对应技能明确回滚待答',()=>{for(const mode of['immune','resist','aux','none']){const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});resistance(s,mode==='aux'?'超频':'害怕',mode==='resist'?100:0);if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='none')s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,mode==='aux'?'超频':'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,29398,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);}const s=make({move:38464,soul:true});resistance(s);assert.throws(()=>observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,38464,20117)),/Q-4923-001/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);});

boundary.assertion: test('4923魂印真实登场异常转换亦依实装逆序，超频转换不再受免异/逐延长影响',()=>{const s=observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.a.build.resistance.slots=[{name:'害怕',chance:0},{name:'',chance:0},{name:'',chance:0}];c.entryAilment(c.a,'害怕',2,c.t);}},()=>make({soul:true,move:29398,loadout:[38460,29397,29396,29395,29398]}));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.cities.map(x=>x.name),['理']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

interaction.assertion: test('4923真实2119初始四蜃楼，四个实装技能顺序的真实异常转超频与逐双向延长',()=>{const s=make({move:29398,soul:true,loadout});resistance(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119.remaining,4);for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'害怕',c.t,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,29398,20117));const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.mirage2119;assert.deepEqual(st.cities.map(x=>x.name),['序','源','逐','理'].slice(0,r));assert.equal(st.remaining,4-r);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['超频'],r+2);}observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'凝滞',c.t,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.t,'凝滞',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(s,38460,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],7);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['凝滞'],7);});

before.trigger: 自身登场时；自身位于出战背包时，双方精灵每次触发复活效果后
futureMechanisms: 真实再次登场
场下精灵持续事件观察
实际队伍复活事件

success.assertion: test('4925真实2120初始登场清强成功才睡眠3，成功递减到2；免疫/强化保护/无强化不递减',()=>{for(const mode of['success','immune','protect','none']){const s=entry(mode);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,mode==='protect'?2:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠'],mode==='success'?3:undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.doctor2120.sleepDuration,mode==='success'?2:3);}});

boundary.assertion: test('4930火土提升唯一最高异常抗性到100，平手及0不提；忽略50%攻击减伤仍不越过攻击免疫',()=>{for(const chances of[[55,18],[50,50],[0,0]]){const s=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');s.fighters[0].build.resistance.slots=[{name:'中毒',chance:chances[0]},{name:'烧伤',chance:chances[1]},{name:'',chance:0}];assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'中毒'),chances[0]>chances[1]?1:chances[0]/100);assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'烧伤'),chances[1]/100);}const s=make({move:38485,index:1}),z=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(s,0,'火土');timer(s,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});timer(z,1,'攻击伤害减免',{fraction:.5});turn(s,38485,20117);turn(z,38485,20117);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(z));const p=make({move:38485,index:1});mark(p,0,'火土');timer(p,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(p,38485,20117);assert.equal(sum(p),0);});

success.name: 4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方
success.assertion: test('4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方',()=>{for(const [atk,spa,form]of[[200,100,'positive'],[100,200,'evil'],[100,100,null]]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk,spa}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,form);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].statusState?.faithSourceSide,form?0:undefined);s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信']=5;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],4);}});

success.name: 4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗
success.assertion: test('4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','skillBan','cut','full']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1150:1300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

success.name: 4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次
success.assertion: test('4933邪气消耗意念为下一次攻击固定附伤，属性与药剂不消费，免固仍消费一次',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,300);s.moveDefinitions[key(38494)].operations=[];if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38494,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.extra,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

success.assertion: test('4933单个当前信仰者HP比例分档增伤减伤有真实状态，未知意念增量单独阻塞不得伪造',()=>{const reduced=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});withoutUnconfirmedAccounting(()=>turn(s,29425,10127));reduced.push(sum(s,'attack',1));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp-reduced.at(-1));}assert.ok(reduced[0]<reduced[1]);const damages=[];for(const hp of[9000,4499]){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}});withoutUnconfirmedAccounting(()=>turn(s,38494,20309));damages.push(sum(s));}assert.ok(damages[1]>damages[0]);const p=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100}});assert.throws(()=>turn(p,29425,10127),/Q-4933-002/);assert.equal(p.round,1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,9000);});

boundary.assertion: test('4933双方信仰合计、意念不减与未消费附伤再授各明确待答，事务回滚保留前态',()=>{for(const mode of['two','freeze','extra']){const s=make({move:38494,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:100,spa:200}}),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128;if(mode==='two')s.fighters[1].statusState={faithSourceSide:0};else st.thought=100;if(mode==='freeze')timer(s,0,'修罗意念不减');if(mode==='extra')st.extra=200;assert.throws(()=>turn(s,38494,20117),new RegExp('Q-4933-00'+({two:1,freeze:3,extra:4}[mode])));assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38494)],5);}});

interaction.name: 4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方
interaction.assertion: test('4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方',()=>{for(const [atk,spa,form]of[[200,100,'positive'],[100,200,'evil'],[100,100,null]]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk,spa}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,form);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].statusState?.faithSourceSide,form?0:undefined);s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信']=5;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],4);}});

interaction.name: 4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗
interaction.assertion: test('4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','skillBan','cut','full']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1150:1300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

interaction.name: 4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方
interaction.assertion: test('4933正邪按战斗开始面板决定，双攻相等两条件皆不触发，当前自身信仰可阻止狂信改指敌方',()=>{for(const [atk,spa,form]of[[200,100,'positive'],[100,200,'evil'],[100,100,null]]){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk,spa}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.form,form);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].statusState?.faithSourceSide,form?0:undefined);s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信']=5;turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29425)],4);}});

interaction.name: 4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗
interaction.assertion: test('4933正气回合初消费意念实际魂印回复，不受技能禁疗、受一般回复削减且满血仍消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','skillBan','cut','full']){const s=make({move:29425,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:200,spa:100},hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought=300;if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,29425,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1150:1300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.shura2128.thought,0);}});

dependencyEvidence.quote: 则己方下只出战精灵本场战斗免疫麻痹状态

before.reviewedBy: Codex sourced current-state verification

success.name: 4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹
success.assertion: test('4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹',()=>{for(const hp of[4500,4501]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,hp===4500?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],hp===4500);}});

success.name: 4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦
success.assertion: test('4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp:high?9000:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(high)c.hurt(c.t,7000,'回初快照降体','direct');else c.heal(c.t,9000,'回初快照回体','soul');c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],!high);}const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,false);});

success.name: 4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合
success.assertion: test('4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中']);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],undefined);});

success.name: 4940初始入场发生的麻痹真实记录，不把尚未开始的回合免疫提前执行
success.assertion: test('4940初始入场发生的麻痹真实记录，不把尚未开始的回合免疫提前执行',()=>{const s=observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1)c.entryAilment(c.t,'麻痹',3,c.a);},()=>make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true}));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.immuneRound,0);});

success.name: 4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强
success.assertion: test('4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强',()=>{for(const reflect of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(reflect)timer(s,0,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,reflect?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],reflect);}});

success.name: 4942/2141在场攻击及固定减半，百分比与真实伤害不减，免伤仍独立
success.assertion: test('4942/2141在场攻击及固定减半，百分比与真实伤害不减，免伤仍独立',()=>{for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent','true']){const values=[];for(const soul of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul});observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,1000,'减伤类型测试',type);},()=>turn(s,10200,type==='attack'?10127:20309));values.push(sum(s,type,1));}assert.ok(Math.abs(values[1]-values[0]*(['attack','fixed'].includes(type)?.5:1))<=1);}});

success.name: 4942/2141回合初无强化攻击增伤50%且忽略自身负级，等级原值不修改
success.assertion: test('4942/2141回合初无强化攻击增伤50%且忽略自身负级，等级原值不修改',()=>{const values=[];for(const atk of[0,-2,-6]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=atk;turn(s,10200,20309);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,atk);}assert.equal(new Set(values).size,1);const p=make({move:10200,index:-1});turn(p,10200,20309);assert.ok(values[0]>=sum(p)*1.48&&values[0]<=sum(p)*1.52);});

success.name: 4942/2141回合初有强化获得3回冰呪并视正为负，真实正级保持，回合内强化变化不重选分支
success.assertion: test('4942/2141回合初有强化获得3回冰呪并视正为负，真实正级保持，回合内强化变化不重选分支',()=>{const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(s,10200,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['冰呪'].end,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ice2141.boosted,true);const p=make({move:10200,index:-1});p.fighters[1].stages.def=-2;timer(p,0,'冰呪');turn(p,10200,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(p));const q=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{spe:10}});turn(q,10200,20117);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].soulState.ice2141.boosted,false);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].effects['冰呪'],undefined);});

failure.name: 4946/2146本批五个已审核非红动态魂印按单来源比例限30%，保留原魂印状态与减伤条件
failure.assertion: test('4946/2146本批五个已审核非红动态魂印按单来源比例限30%，保留原魂印状态与减伤条件',()=>{for(const id of[4823,4826,4830,4834,4888])for(const type of['fixed','percent'])for(const doubled of(id===4826||id===4830?[false,true]:[false])){const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/'+id+'/snapshot.json'),moves=enemy.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth).slice(0,4),loadout=[...moves.map(m=>m.id),enemy.moves.find(m=>m.fifth).id],action=moves.find(m=>m.kind==='status').id,s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:loadout});assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[s.fighters[1].soulId].sourceHash,enemy.souls.at(-1).hash);if(id===4834){s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;s.fighters[1].stages.acc=-6;}const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(c.a.side===1&&(id===4834&&e==='roundEnd'||id===4888&&e==='combatEnd'))return;old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.clearAilments(c.a);if(id===4823){c.t.soulState.snow2014.round=c.round;c.t.soulState.snow2014.removed=5;}if(id===4826||id===4830)c.t.soulState.damageTypes2016={round:c.round,types:doubled?['attack',type==='fixed'?'percent':'fixed']:[]};if(id===4888){c.t.soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart=true;c.t.soulState.ria2075.weakAttack=true;}c.hurt(c.t,1000,'已审核比例魂印专项',type);}}};try{turn(s,29455,action);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const hit=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type===type);assert.ok(hit);assert.equal(hit.settledDamage,(id===4826||id===4830)&&!doubled?750:700);assert.equal(hit.hpLoss,hit.settledDamage);}});

failure.assertion: test('4946/2146低于三分之一危急只一次魂印回复并清敌回合及普通盾，护罩保留；雷辰授予独立待答',()=>{const ability=E.SOULS.registry[2146].abilities,old=ability.gainFour;let requests=0;ability.gainFour=()=>requests++;try{for(const hp of[2999,3000]){const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],300,'ordinary');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],400,'barrier');turn(s,29455,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,hp===2999?9000:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,hp===2999?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.rescueUsed,hp===2999);if(hp===2999){s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s,29455,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);}}assert.equal(requests,1);}finally{ability.gainFour=old;}const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});assert.throws(()=>turn(s,29455,20117),/Q-4946-003/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);});

interaction.name: 4946/2146已知四颗及觉醒流程：仅隔离未确认路径选择，真实清异常负级、三回觉醒0PP用招与红伤回血
interaction.assertion: test('4946/2146已知四颗及觉醒流程：仅隔离未确认路径选择，真实清异常负级、三回觉醒0PP用招与红伤回血',()=>{policies({starPlan:()=>[0,3,1,2]},()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp:2999,loadout:[10006,38536,29455,29456,38538]});s.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['失明']=3;turn(s,29455,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966;assert.deepEqual(st.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(st.connections,[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]]);assert.equal(st.awake.sourceHash,'aab36e4c');assert.equal(st.awake.start,2);assert.equal(st.awake.end,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['失明'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,0);s.fighters[0].hp=4500;s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)]=0;s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');const old=E.SOULS;let crit;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);c.stage(c.t,-1,['atk']);}}};try{turn(s,38536,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(crit,true);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500+sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);turn(s,29455,20309);turn(s,29455,20309);assert.equal(s.round,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.throws(()=>turn(s,38536,20309),/有 PP/);});});

interaction.assertion: test('4946/2146本批五个已审核非红动态魂印按单来源比例限30%，保留原魂印状态与减伤条件',()=>{for(const id of[4823,4826,4830,4834,4888])for(const type of['fixed','percent'])for(const doubled of(id===4826||id===4830?[false,true]:[false])){const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/'+id+'/snapshot.json'),moves=enemy.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth).slice(0,4),loadout=[...moves.map(m=>m.id),enemy.moves.find(m=>m.fifth).id],action=moves.find(m=>m.kind==='status').id,s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:loadout});assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[s.fighters[1].soulId].sourceHash,enemy.souls.at(-1).hash);if(id===4834){s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;s.fighters[1].stages.acc=-6;}const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(c.a.side===1&&(id===4834&&e==='roundEnd'||id===4888&&e==='combatEnd'))return;old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.clearAilments(c.a);if(id===4823){c.t.soulState.snow2014.round=c.round;c.t.soulState.snow2014.removed=5;}if(id===4826||id===4830)c.t.soulState.damageTypes2016={round:c.round,types:doubled?['attack',type==='fixed'?'percent':'fixed']:[]};if(id===4888){c.t.soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart=true;c.t.soulState.ria2075.weakAttack=true;}c.hurt(c.t,1000,'已审核比例魂印专项',type);}}};try{turn(s,29455,action);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const hit=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type===type);assert.ok(hit);assert.equal(hit.settledDamage,(id===4826||id===4830)&&!doubled?750:700);assert.equal(hit.hpLoss,hit.settledDamage);}});
