interaction.name: 4946/2146已知四颗及觉醒流程：仅隔离未确认路径选择，真实清异常负级、三回觉醒0PP用招与红伤回血
interaction.assertion: test('4946/2146已知四颗及觉醒流程：仅隔离未确认路径选择，真实清异常负级、三回觉醒0PP用招与红伤回血',()=>{policies({starPlan:()=>[0,3,1,2]},()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp:2999,loadout:[10006,38536,29455,29456,38538]});s.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['失明']=3;turn(s,29455,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966;assert.deepEqual(st.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(st.connections,[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]]);assert.equal(st.awake.sourceHash,'aab36e4c');assert.equal(st.awake.start,2);assert.equal(st.awake.end,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['失明'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,0);s.fighters[0].hp=4500;s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)]=0;s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');const old=E.SOULS;let crit;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);c.stage(c.t,-1,['atk']);}}};try{turn(s,38536,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(crit,true);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500+sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);turn(s,29455,20309);turn(s,29455,20309);assert.equal(s.round,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.throws(()=>turn(s,38536,20309),/有 PP/);});});

after.rationale: 自身在场的无视正级、先制、回血减伤、胜之道和攻击记录均为自身行为；仅真实场下支援监听与队伍不武授予延期。
after.singleBehavior: 实际攻击忽略对手正级，使用时无强授下轮攻击先制；异常分支两回合50%减攻，无异常两回合末30%魂印回复；场上武道开启胜之道并减对手1分不武；实际抵挡后衍化关闭；当前双方完整红伤记录、次轮50%粉伤与严格小于200翻倍。既有不武当前载荷独立验证，点数多分、留存等未决保留显式错误。
after.deferredBehavior: 存活场下时监听对方不高于10%的抗性触发和通用特性执行，给实际对方队伍添加不武。
after.trigger: 自身真实存活场下、对方触发相应低概率抗性或执行通用特性
futureMechanisms: 场下存活支援者
低概率抗性及通用特性实际触发广播
对方队伍不武状态归属

dependencyEvidence.quote: 自身存活于场下时，对方每次触发概率不高于10%的抗性或执行概率不高于10%的通用特性时，对方获得1分不武

after.verificationNote: 按真实参数记录双方3回合目标约束，普通当前双方技能继续结算。

before.rationale: 团体内部两套HP/PP、角色交换、死亡接替及当前命名强化均属于自身；只延期真实队伍非首发与场下、队伍来源。
before.singleBehavior: 独立主副HP和PP，初始主钺攻击100、攻击先制1及红伤50%；主御速度100与受攻完整红伤等量真伤；副御入场双方净异与2回免异先制2；副钺每300完整当前伤害结束控制；有副位免暴击伤害、忽盾和攻击命中讨；讨零红伤半最大HP粉伤、连诛当前禁疗及血药例外；已持有星皇赐回复翻倍、佑冻结剩余回合，当前3291目标约束。
before.deferredBehavior: 真实队伍非首发初始化御主位及再次出战历史更新；星皇在真实己方背包中的授予目标与场下来源；讨接收场下队友效果后连诛授予，场下连诛HP真伤与真实切换阶段状态保留。
before.trigger: 真实非首发出场、再登场；出战背包星皇提供命名状态；讨持有者成为场下己方效果目标，连诛持有者位于场下
futureMechanisms: 实际队伍位置与首次/再次出战
真实队伍星皇来源及目标选择
场下效果源与连诛持有者
真正换宠过程中的命名状态与计量保留

位于场下的自身受到最大体力1/8的真实伤害
自身位于出战背包时，己方精灵拥有星皇之赐

success.name: 4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹
success.assertion: test('4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(event,c){if(event==='beforeBattleStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.a.ailments['烧伤']=4;c.t.ailments['中毒']=4;}old.run(event,c);}};let s;try{s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4946/snapshot.json'),enemyLoadout:[20085,10171,29455,29456,38538]});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984.amount,2);for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,29466,20085);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']>=r,r===3);}});

success.name: 4950/2149已有讨时真实零红伤附最大HP一半粉伤，未命中不触发，百分比免疫仍归零
success.assertion: test('4950/2149已有讨时真实零红伤附最大HP一半粉伤，未命中不触发，百分比免疫仍归零',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149={sourceSide:0};timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫',{});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});turn(s,38554,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:4500);}const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,hit:false});s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149={sourceSide:0};s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-6;s.fighters[1].effects['物理攻击闪避']={start:1,end:99};turn(s,38554,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);});

success.name: 4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留
success.assertion: test('4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留',()=>{const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999}});turn(s,38568,20309);turn(s,38554,20309);const n=sum(s),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.ok(n>=300);assert.equal(st.remainder,n%300);assert.equal(st.pendingControls,0);const statuses=Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments);assert.ok(statuses.length>0);for(const name of statuses)assert.ok(['麻痹','害怕','疲惫','睡眠','石化','冰封','焚烬','诅咒','感染','神游','空定'].includes(name),name);});

interaction.name: 4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留

failure.name: 4950/2149目标锁定对真实已部署3291星皇之赐和之佑生效，只拦命名强化，不剥除原魂印固粉及免弱
failure.assertion: test('4950/2149目标锁定对真实已部署3291星皇之赐和之佑生效，只拦命名强化，不剥除原魂印固粉及免弱',()=>{const enemy=require('../data/species/3291.json').snapshot;for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[10499,20530,10047,10539,30381],targetHp:1000});assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'entryAilmentRounds'),0);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'pinkImmune'),true);assert.equal(E.SOULS.trait(s.fighters[1],'weaknessImmune'),true);if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,29466,10499);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,reserve?1000:2125);}});

boundary.name: 4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹
boundary.assertion: test('4950/2149御副位登场真实解除双方异常并授2回免异及先制2，过期后允许公共麻痹',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(event,c){if(event==='beforeBattleStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.a.ailments['烧伤']=4;c.t.ailments['中毒']=4;}old.run(event,c);}};let s;try{s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4946/snapshot.json'),enemyLoadout:[20085,10171,29455,29456,38538]});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id984.amount,2);for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,29466,20085);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']>=r,r===3);}});

boundary.name: 4950/2149已有讨时真实零红伤附最大HP一半粉伤，未命中不触发，百分比免疫仍归零
boundary.assertion: test('4950/2149已有讨时真实零红伤附最大HP一半粉伤，未命中不触发，百分比免疫仍归零',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149={sourceSide:0};timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫',{});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫',{});turn(s,38554,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:4500);}const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,hit:false});s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149={sourceSide:0};s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-6;s.fighters[1].effects['物理攻击闪避']={start:1,end:99};turn(s,38554,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);});

boundary.name: 4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留
boundary.assertion: test('4950/2149钺副位每300完整伤害结束实际随机非限制控制，不混入山神或瘫痪，剩余量保留',()=>{const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999}});turn(s,38568,20309);turn(s,38554,20309);const n=sum(s),st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.ok(n>=300);assert.equal(st.remainder,n%300);assert.equal(st.pendingControls,0);const statuses=Object.keys(s.fighters[1].ailments);assert.ok(statuses.length>0);for(const name of statuses)assert.ok(['麻痹','害怕','疲惫','睡眠','石化','冰封','焚烬','诅咒','感染','神游','空定'].includes(name),name);});

boundary.assertion: test('4950/2149连诛当前在场禁疗沿用户血药例外，独立于技能来源禁疗',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].soulState.lianzhu2149={sourceSide:0};turn(s,29466,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1000);turn(s,29466,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1250);});

boundary.name: 4950/2149真实团体两套HP和PP，钺初始攻击加100，2581交换到御速度加100并保留旧资源，再交换恢复
boundary.assertion: test('4950/2149真实团体两套HP和PP，钺初始攻击加100，2581交换到御速度加100并保留旧资源，再交换恢复',()=>{const s=make({move:38554,soul:true,hp:3000}),f=s.fighters[0];f.pp[key(38554)]=1;turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yu');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.atk,180);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spe,600);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38554)],5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.hp,3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yue.pp[key(38554)],1);s.fighters[0].hp=5000;turn(s,38568,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.master,'yue');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38554)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.atk,280);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.spe,500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp,5000);});

boundary.assertion: test('4950/2149主位死亡由真实副位接替，保存0HP与原PP，不进入精灵死亡结算；副位空缺后真正死亡',()=>{const s=make({move:29466,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1});turn(s,29466,10127);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149;assert.equal(st.master,'yu');assert.equal(st.reserve,null);assert.equal(st.bodies.yue.hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.finished,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.deathResolved,undefined);assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),0);s.fighters[0].hp=1;turn(s,29466,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.finished,true);});

interaction.name: 4950/2149有副位攻击真实忽略普通盾，副位空缺后盾正常承伤；命中附讨保留命名状态
interaction.assertion: test('4950/2149有副位攻击真实忽略普通盾，副位空缺后盾正常承伤；命中附讨保留命名状态',()=>{for(const reserve of[true,false]){const s=make({move:38554,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=1000;if(!reserve){s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.reserve=null;s.fighters[0].soulState.group2149.bodies.yu.hp=0;}turn(s,38554,20117);const events=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===1&&e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0);assert.ok(events.length);assert.equal(events.reduce((n,e)=>n+e.hpLoss,0)>0,reserve);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].soulState.tao2149,reserve);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield===1000,reserve);}});

interaction.name: 4950/2149钺主位特殊攻击真实提升50%，面板攻击100不混入特攻计算；副位空缺不取消主位增伤
